Draven.laning: Early on, farm safely instead of fighting Draven while he has two Draven Q Spinning Axes. Don’t carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. If Draven steps forward, create an opening for your jungler to gank and focus on not giving up a kill.
Draven.build: Build armor first because Draven’s main damage is physical. Also get enough health to withstand the execute threshold of Draven R Whirling Death, and consider ways to reduce the damage he deals with basic attacks and attack speed.
Draven.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks, then approach by dashing through a minion with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Send the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to the spot where Draven’s axe will land; if it knocks him up, follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Draven.escape: After Draven E Stand Aside is down, you have a chance to engage with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Draven can gain movement speed with Draven W Blood Rush, so close the distance when he has one or fewer axes and pressure the spot where he’ll catch an axe with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Draven.fight: Start a trade when Draven has one or fewer Draven Q Spinning Axes and Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up. Close the distance by using Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions, but keep a dash available to use on Draven. Hit the spot where an axe will land with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to force Draven to take damage or give up the axe.
Draven.phase: Yasuo gets stronger in the mid to late game once he has at least two critical strike items, so look for Draven when he’s caught alone.
Draven.teamfight: Instead of engaging first, find an angle from the flank and use Yasuo R Last Breath when your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an allied knockup hits. Pressure the spot where Draven’s axe will land to reduce his damage, then target Draven in the backline.
Draven.watch: Avoid trading early while Draven is holding two Draven Q Spinning Axes. Draven E Stand Aside is a displacement spell that disrupts Yasuo’s engage, so check whether he has used it before going in. When your health is low, watch out for the execute from Draven R Whirling Death, and move out of its return path even if you dodged the first hit.

Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early while Yasuo is weak, so limit trades and don’t give him a kill. In the mid game, even if you can use Yasuo R Last Breath, wait for Olaf R Ragnarok to end. In the late game, Olaf is relatively weak while Yasuo becomes strong with at least two critical strike items.
Olaf.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Olaf Q Undertow. Olaf E Reckless Swing’s true damage can’t be reduced by resistances, so also build health. Then stack critical strike items for Yasuo’s power spike.
Olaf.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks. Use minions and Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to approach, then hit with the circular area of your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash. If you successfully knock Olaf up while Olaf R Ragnarok is not active, follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Olaf.escape: Approach when Olaf Q Undertow misses and he can’t retrieve his axe. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, use minions as an escape route with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to create distance, then engage again after it ends. If you use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade directly on Olaf, you can’t use it on the same target again for a short time, so check your escape route first.
Olaf.fight: Look for an opportunity to engage with a knock-up right after Olaf R Ragnarok ends. Olaf gains attack speed and healing as his health gets lower, so don’t recklessly engage just because he’s at half health.
Olaf.laning: Survive the early game without giving Olaf a kill, and don’t carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Leave minions as platforms for engaging and escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Dodge the direction Olaf Q Undertow’s axe lands and block his route to retrieve it.
Olaf.teamfight: Instead of starting a team fight as Yasuo, look for an angle from the flank and wait for an ally’s knock-up or your own Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance and let it run out; after it ends, chain a knock-up into Yasuo R Last Breath. After engaging, focus on taking out the backline.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow slows and reduces armor, so dodge the axe and use Yasuo W Wind Wall against the incoming axe. Move opposite the direction the axe lands to prevent Olaf from retrieving it. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, which resistances can’t reduce, and while Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don’t rely on Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s knock-up or Yasuo R Last Breath to close in.

Jhin.build: Build armor first to prepare for Jhin’s primary damage. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Jhin E Captive Audience. If the enemy team can hold Yasuo with crowd control, buy Quicksilver Sash between your core items.
Jhin.combo: Prepare stacks by hitting minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then approach Jhin with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions. Use Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash and follow with a basic attack as soon as you land. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks Jhin up, immediately follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Jhin.escape: Engaging after Jhin W Deadly Flourish misses or has been used reduces the risk of being rooted. Jhin has no ability to create distance on his own, so use that opening to close in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions. If you may need to retreat, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on Jhin and keep a minion as a stepping stone to escape.
Jhin.fight: Start trading while Jhin is reloading or just after he fires one or two shots, when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks are ready. Approach using minions as stepping stones, hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the Yasuo E Sweeping Blade dash, then follow with a basic attack.
Jhin.laning: Early on, avoid risky trades and don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Keep minions as stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape, and stand away from low-health minions to avoid empowered Jhin Q Dancing Grenade. Keep moving to charge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield.
Jhin.phase: Yasuo’s power grows in the mid to late game as he builds two or more critical strike items.
Jhin.teamfight: Don’t dive in first. Take an angle from the side while watching for Jhin’s traps, Jhin W Deadly Flourish, and Jhin R Curtain Call shots. You can block Jhin R Curtain Call’s shots by placing Yasuo W Wind Wall before they fire. Use Yasuo R Last Breath off an ally’s knock-up or the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to go in and target the backline.
Jhin.watch: When Jhin P Whisper’s final shot is ready, back off to avoid taking heavy damage. Right after you’re hit by Jhin’s basic attack or Jhin E Captive Audience, move out of the narrow line of Jhin W Deadly Flourish to avoid being rooted. Also watch out for Jhin R Curtain Call’s shots, which deal more damage the lower your health is.

Aatrox.teamfight: Don’t engage first. Find an angle from the flank and look for a Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado or an ally’s knock-up. When an enemy is airborne, go in with Yasuo R Last Breath, then target the backline once you have armor penetration.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and W Infernal Chains. Aatrox heals with P Deathbringer Stance, E Umbral Dash, and R World Ender, so if the duel runs long, get Executioner's Calling for Grievous Wounds. Aatrox has fairly high armor, so consider armor penetration when building damage.
Aatrox.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build stacks. When Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down, approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade by dashing through minions. Cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit with its circular area, then follow with a basic attack as you land. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks him up, immediately follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Aatrox.escape: The moment Aatrox E Umbral Dash goes down is an opening to engage with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Leave a minion available to move to in case of Aatrox W Infernal Chains, and if the chain hits, prioritize leaving its area over engaging. If Aatrox R World Ender is active, create distance and re-engage after it expires.
Aatrox.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is charged and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Look for an opening just after Aatrox uses his empowered P Deathbringer Stance attack on a minion or Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down.
Aatrox.laning: In the early game, avoid giving up kills and collect CS while moving to charge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield. Keep the wave from pushing carelessly with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, since minions are stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape. Avoid trading right after your shield breaks, and look for an opening when Aatrox uses his empowered P Deathbringer Stance attack on a minion.
Aatrox.phase: Yasuo becomes stronger in the mid to late game once he has at least two critical strike items, so limit early losses and play for that timing.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is his main source of damage and has a knock-up. Watch its cast animation and use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to dash inward or move beyond its outer edge to avoid being hit by the sword's tip. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, leave its area immediately before it pulls you in. When Aatrox R World Ender is active, his healing increases, so stop dueling and create distance.

Anivia.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks, then approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash. If the tornado from your third Q knocks Anivia up, immediately follow with Yasuo R Last Breath. If Anivia P Rebirth is still available, get help from allies to destroy the egg.
Anivia.escape: When Anivia Q Flash Frost is down and you can avoid the stun, close the gap by dashing through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Anivia has no mobility, so save an E dash for her as you approach. Avoid engaging in narrow paths where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your escape.
Anivia.build: Anivia’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If healing from Anivia P Rebirth makes the duel drag on, get Executioner's Calling for Grievous Wounds.
Anivia.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is active and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Dash through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, passing beside Anivia, and cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash. Follow with a basic attack as you land.
Anivia.laning: Minions are stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape, so don’t push the wave carelessly with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Anivia.phase: Yasuo gets stronger in the mid to late game once he has at least two critical strike items, but choose where to fight with Anivia’s terrain control in mind.
Anivia.teamfight: Avoid narrow jungle or river paths where Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape, and fight in a wide lane. Don’t engage first; use Yasuo R Last Breath when your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado or an ally knocks an enemy up. After engaging, focus on taking out the backline.
Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost detonates when recast and stuns, so block it with Yasuo W Wind Wall as it approaches or use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to dash through its blast radius. If Q hits you or you’re chilled inside Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage, so leave the storm immediately.

Aphelios.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is active and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions when Aphelios has a weapon with low burst or isn’t holding Severum. Save Yasuo W Wind Wall for the enemy’s key ranged projectile.
Aphelios.build: Build armor first to reduce Aphelios’s main physical damage. If the fight runs long because of the healing from Aphelios E Weapon Queue System and R Moonlight Vigil, get Executioner's Calling for Grievous Wounds next. If the enemy composition starts with a root, fit Quicksilver Sash between your core items.
Aphelios.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build stacks, then approach by following the minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit with its circular area, then follow with a basic attack as you land. If your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks Aphelios up, immediately use Yasuo R Last Breath.
Aphelios.escape: Delay engaging while Aphelios’s Gravitum slow and the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites are a threat. Approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade after he uses the root or while he isn’t holding Severum. When you need to retreat, dash straight at Aphelios and leave minions available to use as stepping stones.
Aphelios.laning: Minions are stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape, so don’t push the wave carelessly with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Retreat when marked by Aphelios’s Calibrum so you don’t keep losing health to its mark.
Aphelios.phase: Yasuo gets stronger in the mid to late game with at least two critical strike items, but check Aphelios’s weapon at the time of the fight.
Aphelios.teamfight: Spread out from allies so the damage from Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil doesn’t hit multiple people. Find an angle from the flank instead of engaging first, then use Yasuo R Last Breath when your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally knocks an enemy up. Target Aphelios when he isn’t holding Severum to take out the backline.
Aphelios.watch: If Aphelios’s Gravitum basic attack slows you, immediately leave his range to avoid the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil triggers one additional attack from his main weapon on each champion hit, so spread out from allies when he can cast it. If marked by Calibrum, retreat because he can hit you again from outside his range.

Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte blocks attacks and immobilizing effects. If it blocks Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s knock-up, it also stuns. Don’t engage with your tornado while Fiora W Riposte is ready. When Fiora uses Riposte, move sideways to dodge the counterattack. If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, stay against a wall to block one of your vital spots.
Fiora.build: Build armor first to prepare for the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. If Fiora P Duelist's Dance and Fiora R Grand Challenge healing make the duel drag on, get Executioner's Calling for Grievous Wounds. Armor doesn’t work against the true damage from her vitals, and Fiora R Grand Challenge scales with your maximum health, so be careful about choices that greatly increase health alone.
Fiora.combo: Hit twice with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build stacks, but don’t rush the third tornado while Fiora W Riposte is available. Once Riposte is down, dash through a minion with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to pass by Fiora, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow up with a basic attack as soon as you land. If the tornado knocks her up, use Yasuo R Last Breath immediately.
Fiora.escape: Right after you force Fiora to use Fiora Q Lunge, you have a chance to approach her. If Fiora W Riposte is also down, close the distance with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and look for a knockup with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. When you need to retreat, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on Fiora and keep minions as stepping stones for your escape.
Fiora.fight: Take a short trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and you have two stacks of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Stand on the side opposite the marked vital and use the moment Fiora lunges toward it as a chance to counterattack. Don’t chase recklessly after the trade.
Fiora.laning: Keep minions as stepping stones for engaging or escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Keep moving to charge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield.
Fiora.teamfight: If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, stay against a wall so she cannot hit all four vitals. Don’t engage first; wait for your own tornado or an allied knockup, then go in with Yasuo R Last Breath. After going in, focus on cutting off the backline.

Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither lowers your movement and attack speed, making it harder to chase and attack, so don’t stay within its range alone for long. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces your armor, so leave the area. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, his health and defenses increase and he deals damage around him based on maximum health, so let it run out unless you have a clear advantage.
Nasus.build: Build armor first against Nasus’s main damage, Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Nasus E Spirit Fire and Nasus R Fury of the Sands, so consider magic resistance if that damage is a problem. When you’re in the area of Nasus E Spirit Fire, which reduces your armor, getting out matters more than stacking additional resistance.
Nasus.combo: Hit twice with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build stacks, then use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to approach and hit with the circular area of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks Nasus up, follow immediately with Yasuo R Last Breath. If you may need to retreat, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on Nasus and leave minions as an escape route.
Nasus.escape: Nasus has no ability to create distance on his own, so it’s a good time to engage when Nasus W Wither is down and Nasus R Fury of the Sands has ended. Close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions, but save Yasuo E Sweeping Blade for Nasus when chasing. Don’t go deep alone if Nasus W Wither is still available.
Nasus.fight: When your shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks, use minions as platforms to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, then cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash and follow with a basic attack after landing. Don’t take a long fight if you’re hit by Nasus W Wither or Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active.
Nasus.laning: If you push Nasus under his turret, it becomes easier for him to stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, so let the lane come to you. Don’t carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions as platforms for engaging and escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Pressure Nasus when he comes out to last-hit, and call for a jungle gank when the lane is pushed toward you.
Nasus.phase: Yasuo gets stronger in the mid to late game with at least two critical strike items, but Nasus keeps stacking Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, so keep pressuring him to prevent him from scaling.
Nasus.teamfight: Instead of engaging first as Yasuo, look for an angle from the flank and join with Yasuo R Last Breath when your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado or an ally’s knock-up lands. Don’t face Nasus head-on while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active; keep your distance. After Yasuo R Last Breath, focus on taking out the backline.

Azir.build: Build magic resistance before armor against Azir’s damage. Get enough movement speed to leave the area his soldiers attack, and aim for at least two critical strike items, which make Yasuo stronger in the mid to late game.
Azir.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks, then use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions to approach beside Azir. If the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks him up, immediately follow with Yasuo R Last Breath. In a short trade, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the Yasuo E Sweeping Blade dash to hit with its circular area, then land a basic attack right after landing.
Azir.escape: The moment after you force Azir to use E Shifting Sands is another window to close the gap. If Azir Q Conquering Sands is also down and the soldiers have stopped, approach by chaining Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions. After Azir R Emperor's Divide is down, the risk of being pushed back is lower, so look for a knock-up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Azir.fight: Take short trades while Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Once Azir Q Conquering Sands is down and the soldiers have stopped, chain Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions to approach from the side, then hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash and follow with basic attacks.
Azir.laning: Minions are paths to engage or escape with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don't carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Azir.phase: Yasuo gets stronger in the mid to late game as he builds critical strike items, but Azir also grows stronger over time, so burst him with a short trade when you get on him.
Azir.teamfight: Don't dive in first; take an angle from the side, then engage with Yasuo R Last Breath off your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally's knock-up. Avoid narrow passages and enter from multiple directions in open areas so you aren't all pushed back by Azir R Emperor's Divide. After engaging, focus on taking out the backline.
Azir.watch: Standing in the line of soldiers summoned by Azir W Arise! leaves you taking continuous damage, so approach Azir from the side or behind. Azir Q Conquering Sands can move the soldiers and slow you, so engage after it is down and the soldiers have stopped. In narrow passages, Azir R Emperor's Divide can push multiple people back together.

Kayle.build: Get Executioner's Calling early to reduce healing from Kayle W Celestial Blessing. Magic resistance protects against Kayle’s main damage, but Kayle Q Radiant Blast reduces it, so dodge a direct hit.
Kayle.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks, then use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion to dash past Kayle and cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash. If the knock-up lands, check whether Kayle uses Kayle R Divine Judgment before following up with Yasuo R Last Breath. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don’t pour on damage during her invulnerability; run out the duration with a knock-up, then attack.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility spell, so after dodging Kayle Q Radiant Blast, look for a chance to approach through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Kayle can escape with the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing, so engage when you can land Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s knock-up.
Kayle.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Use minions as stepping stones to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, and save a Yasuo E Sweeping Blade for the enemy. When Kayle R Divine Judgment activates, keep her locked down with a knock-up instead of dealing damage, then attack again when her invulnerability ends.
Kayle.teamfight: Create a path to reach Kayle from the flank or out of vision instead of spending time on the frontline. Go in with Yasuo R Last Breath after an ally’s knock-up or Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. If Kayle R Divine Judgment activates, don’t pour on damage; run out her invulnerability with a knock-up, then attack again.
Kayle.watch: Dodge a direct hit from Kayle Q Radiant Blast, which slows and reduces armor and magic resistance. Kayle W Celestial Blessing can heal and increase movement speed. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, damage is blocked.
Kayle.laning: Don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions to engage or escape with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.

Lissandra.build: First, build magic resistance rather than armor against Lissandra’s magic damage. If the crowd control from Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is a problem, fit Quicksilver Sash between core items. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb’s healing lets her survive a duel, get Executioner's Calling to reduce healing.
Lissandra.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks. When Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down, approach through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, hit her with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow with a basic attack. If the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado knocks her up, immediately use Yasuo R Last Breath, but don’t dump all your damage at once if Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is still available.
Lissandra.escape: Look for an opening just after Lissandra uses Lissandra W Ring of Frost on the wave or misses it. Close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade just after Lissandra uses Lissandra E Glacial Path. If the claw is in flight and Lissandra has not recast it yet, look for a chance to stop her movement with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s knock-up.
Lissandra.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. When Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down, approach through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, hit her with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest in a circle during the dash, then follow with a basic attack. If Lissandra E Glacial Path is also down, look for a chance to close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and Yasuo R Last Breath.
Lissandra.laning: Stand at an angle to allied minions to avoid the path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard. Refill Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield by moving, and avoid trading just after poke breaks it. Don’t carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; keep minions available as stepping stones for engaging or escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Lissandra.teamfight: Set up an angle from the flank instead of engaging first, then go in with Yasuo R Last Breath after an ally’s knock-up or Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado. Check whether Lissandra E Glacial Path is already down to help choose a target. Time your damage around the end of Lissandra R Frozen Tomb’s damage immunity, and target the backline after you engage.
Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting its first target, so don’t stand in a line with allied minions. If caught by Lissandra W Ring of Frost’s root or Lissandra R Frozen Tomb’s stun, Yasuo Q Steel Tempest is easy to interrupt and you can take heavy damage. If Lissandra casts Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on herself, she becomes immune to damage, so don’t spend your finishing damage during that time.
Lissandra.phase: Yasuo's power spike comes in the mid-to-late game, as he builds at least two critical strike items.

Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first against Malphite’s main damage from Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force. Malphite’s high armor makes Yasuo’s physical damage easy to block, so prioritize damage that scales with maximum health or deals magic damage.
Malphite.combo: First break Malphite P Granite Shield and land Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice to build stacks. Approach through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, hit him with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest in a circle during the dash, then follow with a basic attack as you land. If the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado knocks him up, follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Malphite.escape: Look for a chance to engage after Malphite E Ground Slam is down. When Malphite R Unstoppable Force is unavailable, he can’t escape with his ultimate, so close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and look for an angle to knock him up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. If you need to retreat, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on the enemy and keep minions available as stepping stones to escape.
Malphite.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then approach through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade after Malphite E Ground Slam is down. If you’re hit by Malphite Q Seismic Shard, don’t engage while slowed.
Malphite.laning: Don’t carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; keep minions available as stepping stones for engaging or escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. After breaking Malphite P Granite Shield, poke again after a short interval so he has no time to restore it.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force doesn’t knock up several of you together. Don’t rush in when Malphite’s location is unknown. Counterattack just after Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down, and go in with Yasuo R Last Breath after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally’s knock-up. Target the backline after your ultimate.
Malphite.watch: After being hit by Malphite Q Seismic Shard, the slow makes it hard to engage or disengage, so don’t start a trade right away. Malphite E Ground Slam reduces attack speed and Yasuo’s damage, so engage after it’s down. Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash, so when you don’t know where Malphite is, don’t group with allies near walls or bushes.
Malphite.phase: Yasuo grows stronger in the mid-to-late game after building at least two critical strike items, so look for an angle to engage in teamfights.

Mel.build: Build magic resistance against Mel’s main damage, and consider health to help survive her execute range. If the enemy composition starts fights with crowd control, fit Quicksilver Sash between core items.
Mel.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build stacks, then approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash. Confirm that Mel W Rebuttal is down, then immediately follow the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado knock-up with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Mel.escape: Look for a chance to engage just after dodging Mel E Solar Snare’s root by stepping to the side. Mel has no mobility spell, so close the gap through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, but save a Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to use on Mel when you chase.
Mel.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Use minions as stepping stones to dash past Mel with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, hit her with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow with a basic attack after landing. If Mel W Rebuttal is still available, don’t rush to throw your tornado.
Mel.laning: Minions are stepping stones for engaging or escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t carelessly clear them with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. When an opportunity comes, pressure the lane to slow Mel’s growth.
Mel.phase: Yasuo also gets strong in the mid to late game with two or more critical strike items, but Mel R Golden Eclipse keeps scaling over time, so pressure Mel from the early game.
Mel.teamfight: Don’t engage first; set up an angle from the flank and watch for Mel E Solar Snare’s root. If Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado or an ally’s knock-up lands, go in with Yasuo R Last Breath and target the backline.
Mel.watch: Mel E Solar Snare roots you if it hits at the center, and Mel Q Radiant Volley can follow up, so dodge it by stepping to the side. If Mel has hit you several times, back off and watch for the execute from Mel P Searing Brilliance even if you still have health. While Overwhelm stacks remain, Mel R Golden Eclipse can reach you from afar, so wait somewhere safe.

MissFortune.build: Miss Fortune’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Armor doesn’t block the magic damage from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. Yasuo gets stronger in the mid to late game with two or more critical strike items.
MissFortune.combo: Land Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice, then knock her up with the third tornado. Immediately follow with Yasuo R Last Breath. To approach, close the gap by dashing through a minion with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, and save a Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to use on Miss Fortune when you chase.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no mobility spell, so look for an angle to engage from outside the slow field of Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. If she escapes with Miss Fortune W Strut, hit her once to reset her movement speed, then follow with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
MissFortune.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion to dash past Miss Fortune, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow with a basic attack as you land. Miss Fortune has no skill to create distance, so pressure her with a knock-up once you’re on her.
MissFortune.laning: Minions are stepping stones for engaging or escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. After Miss Fortune hits a minion, create distance to avoid her empowered basic attack, and don’t stand directly behind a minion.
MissFortune.teamfight: Don’t engage where Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is placed; draw the enemy out of the area. Set up an angle from the flank, then go in with Yasuo R Last Breath after an ally’s knock-up or Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado. If Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, interrupt it with a knock-up and pressure the backline.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up ricochets off minions, so don’t stand in a line with them. If Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is placed, delay your engage because of the slow. When Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, interrupt it with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s knock-up or move beside the cone.
MissFortune.phase: Yasuo grows stronger in the mid-to-late game after building at least two critical strike items.

Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If the duel drags on because of the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust, get Executioner's Calling to reduce his healing.
Tryndamere.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to prepare stacks. When Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, use minions as stepping stones to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, knock him up with the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then follow with Yasuo R Last Breath. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, don’t rush your finishing damage; let it run out.
Tryndamere.escape: The moment after you bait out Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is your chance to engage with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. However, Tryndamere’s critical strikes reduce the cooldown of Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, so avoid chasing where there are many minions and look for a knockup with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest right after his mobility spell is down.
Tryndamere.fight: Start trading when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to approach from the side, hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest in a circle during the dash, then follow with an auto attack. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage activates, create distance and deal damage again after it ends.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, harass Tryndamere to keep him from last-hitting, reducing his Fury and the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust. Don’t push the wave carelessly with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions as stepping stones for engaging or escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. When Tryndamere hits minions to build Fury, create distance before fighting at close range.
Tryndamere.phase: After learning Yasuo R Last Breath, you gain kill opportunities through knockups. Yasuo gets stronger in the mid to late game as you build two or more critical strike items, but create distance while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Rather than engaging first, Yasuo waits for his own Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally’s knockup, then follows with Yasuo R Last Breath. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage activates, don’t dump damage trying to kill him; buy time with a knockup or create distance. To catch Tryndamere in a side lane, check whether his ultimate is available. If you can’t check, send more players or trade for an objective.
Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere P Battle Fury makes his critical strikes threatening as it builds, so create distance when he starts hitting minions to build Fury. Tryndamere W Mocking Shout slows you if you turn your back and retreat, so walk backward while facing him, and avoid trading auto attacks right after it hits. Tryndamere R Undying Rage makes him unkillable, so instead of dealing as much damage as possible, buy time with the knockup from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or create distance.

Ahri.build: Prioritize a way to interrupt or remove Ahri E Charm, and build magic resistance against her magic damage. If Ahri is sustaining through fights with P Essence Theft, get Executioner's Calling for Grievous Wounds. Magic resistance does not reduce the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception.
Ahri.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks, then approach by dashing through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. When chasing, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to save a dash for Ahri.
Ahri.escape: The moment Ahri E Charm goes down is an opening to engage. While Ahri R Spirit Rush is down, close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and look for a knock-up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. If Ahri R Spirit Rush is available, keep in mind that she can use it to create distance.
Ahri.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is active and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Dash through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, passing beside Ahri, and cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash. Follow with a basic attack as you land. If Ahri E Charm is down, use that opening to engage and fight.
Ahri.laning: Keep minions between you and Ahri to dodge Ahri E Charm, and keep moving to charge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield. Don’t push the wave carelessly with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, since minions are stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape. Avoid trading right after poke breaks your shield.
Ahri.phase: Yasuo becomes stronger in the mid to late game once he has at least two critical strike items.
Ahri.teamfight: Find an angle from the flank instead of engaging first, and look for the moment Ahri E Charm goes down. Use Yasuo R Last Breath when Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally knocks an enemy up. Then focus on taking out the backline, including the low-armor Ahri.
Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits, you can easily take all the follow-up damage, so move behind minions and dodge it. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can also hit on the return, and that return damage is true damage, so even after dodging the first pass, move out of its return path.

Akali.build: Early on, prioritize magic resistance and health to withstand Akali’s magic damage. Later, build at least two critical strike items to make use of Yasuo’s mid to late game strength.
Akali.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to prepare its stacks, then use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions and cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit with its circular area. Follow with a basic attack as you land. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks Akali up, immediately use Yasuo R Last Breath.
Akali.escape: Look to engage after dodging the first projectile from Akali E Shuriken Flip, or once Akali W Twilight Shroud and E Shuriken Flip are down. If only one of her mobility tools is down, she can escape with the other, so look especially for an opening before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up.
Akali.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is active and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. When Akali comes out of Akali W Twilight Shroud to attack, trade back with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash. While Akali R Perfect Execution is unavailable, close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and look for a chance to knock her up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Akali.laning: Don’t push the wave carelessly with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions as stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape.
Akali.phase: Use Yasuo’s strengths to fight in the mid to late game, once he has at least two critical strike items.
Akali.teamfight: Find an angle from the flank instead of starting the fight yourself, then use Yasuo R Last Breath on an enemy knocked up by an ally or Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Akali briefly becomes visible when she enters Akali W Twilight Shroud, so look for a chance to hit her with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest then.
Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first projectile from Akali E Shuriken Flip. If it hits and marks you, the second dash will follow you if you try to escape, so raise Yasuo W Wind Wall before the projectile arrives. You can’t dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking, and the second hit gets stronger based on your missing health, so save Yasuo E Sweeping Blade for when Akali closes in.

Akshan.build: Build armor first against Akshan’s main damage from Akshan Q Avengerang, E Heroic Swing, and R Comeuppance. Then build critical strike items to increase Yasuo’s strength, but don’t stand within range of Akshan R Comeuppance with health reduced.
Akshan.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks. Once Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions.
Akshan.escape: The moment Akshan E Heroic Swing goes down is an opening to engage with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. When chasing, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion first to save a dash for Akshan. When you need to retreat, leave minions available as stepping stones.
Akshan.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is active and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Right after you bait out Akshan E Heroic Swing, close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions and knock him up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to limit his chance to escape.
Akshan.laning: Akshan Q Avengerang can gain range by passing through minions, so don’t rely on standing only behind the wave. Don’t push the wave carelessly with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions as stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape.
Akshan.phase: Yasuo gets stronger in the mid to late game once he has at least two critical strike items, so fight around prepared knock-ups.
Akshan.teamfight: Wait for a knock-up from your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally, then go in with Yasuo R Last Breath instead of engaging first. If you have a Scoundrel mark from killing one of Akshan’s allies, fight outside finishing range so Akshan can’t catch you alone. Akshan E Heroic Swing ends if he collides with a champion while swinging, so you can get in front of his path to stop it.
Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits a minion, so don’t assume you’re safe behind the wave; dodge its outbound and return paths. Yasuo W Wind Wall can block the boomerang, but it won’t stop a projectile that arrived before the wall formed, so use it early. If you’re low and targeted by Akshan R Comeuppance, don’t run alone through open ground; get behind terrain.

Annie.build: Build magic resistance first against Annie’s damage. Don’t rely on resistance alone to endure the penetration from Annie R Summon: Tibbers; then build at least two critical strike items for Yasuo’s mid to late game strength.
Annie.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to prepare its stacks. When Annie P Pyromania’s stun is down, approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions.
Annie.escape: The moment Annie P Pyromania’s stun is used is an opening to engage. If you need an escape route, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on Annie and leave minions available to dash through as you retreat. Keep your distance from Tibbers after Annie R Summon: Tibbers is cast.
Annie.fight: Start trades when Annie P Pyromania’s stun is down and Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is active. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to pass beside Annie, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, and follow with a basic attack as you land.
Annie.laning: Keep moving to charge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield, and don’t push the wave carelessly with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions as stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape.
Annie.phase: Yasuo’s health and trading are weak early, so survive while avoiding Annie’s stun. Yasuo’s strong window is the mid to late game, once he has at least two critical strike items.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie is missing or Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, stand apart from allies so you aren’t hit together by the area stun from Annie R Summon: Tibbers. Find an angle from the flank instead of starting the fight, then use Yasuo R Last Breath when your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado or an ally knocks an enemy up. Decide in advance which allies will immediately take down Annie when she engages.
Annie.watch: When white light swirls around Annie, Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, so stay out of her ability range. Create distance so multiple allies aren’t hit together by the area stun from Annie R Summon: Tibbers. After Tibbers is summoned, don’t stay where it was, even if you’ve killed Annie.

AurelionSol.build: Build magic resistance first against Aurelion Sol's main damage. Since Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on your maximum health, avoid relying on a large health increase alone, and also get enough health to escape Aurelion Sol E Singularity's execute zone. Also consider movement speed to leave telegraphed areas.
AurelionSol.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build stacks, then approach Aurelion Sol with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions. Cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit with its circular area, then follow up with a basic attack after landing. If the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado knocks him up, immediately use Yasuo R Last Breath.
AurelionSol.escape: The moment after you force Aurelion Sol to use W Astral Flight is your chance to approach. If Aurelion Sol E Singularity and the crowd control from Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend are also down, close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions and look for an angle to knock him up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
AurelionSol.fight: When Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, use minions as dashes with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to approach and hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash. Don't tank Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light; move out of its aim.
AurelionSol.laning: Don't carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions as paths to engage or escape with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Stand behind minions when harassed, and avoid fighting just after Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield is broken.
AurelionSol.phase: However, Aurelion Sol P Cosmic Creator's Stardust stacks permanently, so the longer you let him scale, the harder he is to deal with.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Take an angle from the side instead of engaging first, then go in with Yasuo R Last Breath off the Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado or an ally's knock-up. Create space from allies and avoid grouping in narrow passages so you aren't all hit by the empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend area knock-up. After engaging, focus on taking out the backline.
AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on your maximum health, and hitting you for longer adds bonus damage and Stardust, so stand behind minions or quickly move out of its aim. Yasuo W Wind Wall cannot block beam abilities, so don't use it to block Q. When low on health, avoid the execute zone of Aurelion Sol E Singularity, and spread out so you and your allies aren't hit together by the empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.

Aurora.build: Get Executioner's Calling first to reduce healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration. Build magic resistance against the damage from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, Aurora Q Twofold Hex, and Aurora E The Weirding.
Aurora.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks, then approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions. Once Aurora E The Weirding and Aurora W Across the Veil are down and Aurora is visible, dash toward her with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and hit with the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest using its circular area. If the knock-up lands, follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Aurora.escape: If only Aurora E The Weirding is down, Aurora can escape with Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora R Between Worlds, so don't rush the chase. If both Aurora E The Weirding and Aurora W Across the Veil are down, and Aurora R Between Worlds is not back up yet, close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and look for a knock-up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Aurora.fight: Start trading while Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions and draw out Aurora E The Weirding, then go back in after she uses more of her mobility. If you are hit by Aurora Q Twofold Hex while low on health, don't extend the trade.
Aurora.laning: Don't carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions as paths to engage or escape with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Keep moving to recharge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield, and avoid trading just after Aurora's harass breaks it.
Aurora.phase: Yasuo gets stronger in the mid to late game after building at least two critical strike items, so look for a duel while Aurora's mobility is down.
Aurora.teamfight: Instead of opening the fight, take an angle from the side, then engage with Yasuo R Last Breath off your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally's knock-up. If Aurora has leapt in and nobody has been killed, use that as your chance to catch her. If an ally is killed, Aurora's leap cooldown resets, so don't leave low-health allies behind when retreating.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when recalled, and the recall damage increases as you lose more health. If cursed, move out of the line between Aurora and you, and retreat before the recall if your health is low. Decide whether to leave or fight inside before Aurora R Between Worlds forms. If Aurora has gone invisible with W Across the Veil, save your targeted dash until she reappears.

Caitlyn.build: Prioritize tenacity and movement speed to deal with being hit while trapped. Prioritize armor to reduce Caitlyn's main damage when building resistances. If the enemy team starts fights with crowd control that locks you down, fit Quicksilver Sash between core items.
Caitlyn.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to prepare two stacks. Dash through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, pass Caitlyn, and cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash. If the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado knocks her up, immediately use Yasuo R Last Breath.
Caitlyn.escape: Avoid paths with Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, and close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions along a route that avoids the traps. Look for an opening when Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker's cast animation is visible or just after she uses it to clear the wave.
Caitlyn.fight: Start trading while Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash and follow with a basic attack right after landing.
Caitlyn.laning: Early on, don't overextend and give up a kill; farm under your turret. Keep Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield charged by moving, and avoid trading just after Caitlyn's harass breaks it. Minions are paths to engage or escape with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don't carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Caitlyn.phase: Caitlyn's relative strength falls over time, while Yasuo gets strong in the mid to late game after building at least two critical strike items.
Caitlyn.teamfight: Don't engage first; take an angle from the side and wait for the Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado or an ally's knock-up. When an enemy is airborne, engage with Yasuo R Last Breath and target the backline. If Caitlyn R Ace in the Hole is aimed at an ally, you can step into the bullet's path and take the hit instead.
Caitlyn.watch: Being caught in Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap increases the range of Caitlyn P Headshot and exposes you to heavy damage. Watch for traps in brush and narrow passages, and change your approach path. When harassed by Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker, stand behind allied minions and let them take the hit first.

Camille.build: Build armor first against Camille's main damage. However, armor cannot reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol. If Camille W Tactical Sweep's healing makes it hard to endure trades, get Executioner's Calling to reduce healing.
Camille.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks, then dash toward minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to knock Camille up. Follow with Yasuo R Last Breath and basic attacks. If you use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade directly on Camille, you can't use it on the same target again for a short time, so plan your approach path before going in.
Camille.escape: Your chance to engage comes when Camille E Hookshot is down and Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is not back up yet. Close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions and knock her up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to prevent her escape. Leave minions as a path to retreat.
Camille.fight: Start trading while Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions to pass Camille, hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, and follow with a basic attack right after landing. If Camille P Adaptive Defenses shield is active, re-engage after it has been stripped away.
Camille.laning: Don't carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or retreat. Stay away from walls and among minions, and keep moving to recharge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield.
Camille.phase: From the mid game onward, don't leave Camille free to split push and take turrets quickly. Yasuo comes into his strength in the mid to late game after building at least two critical strike items.
Camille.teamfight: Take an angle from the side instead of starting the fight, then engage with Yasuo R Last Breath off your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado or an ally's knock-up. After engaging, target the backline and make use of the armor penetration from Yasuo R Last Breath.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot starts from a wall and stuns, so stay away from walls and create distance when Camille heads toward one. The second empowered basic attack from Camille Q Precision Protocol includes true damage, so back away while she prepares it. When Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum begins, don't use a counter ability; hold out until the zone ends.

Chogath.build: Get Executioner's Calling early to reduce healing, since the healing from Cho'Gath P Carnivore makes trades drag on. Build magic resistance against the damage from Cho'Gath Q Rupture, Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, and Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. Resistances don't work against the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast, and a large health increase alone also makes Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes deal more damage.
Chogath.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to maintain stacks, then use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions to pass Cho'Gath when you engage. Cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit with its circular area, then follow with a basic attack right after landing. If the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado knocks him up, follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Chogath.escape: Cho'Gath has no mobility, so your chance to engage is right after he uses Cho'Gath Q Rupture on the wave. Go in after avoiding the front of Cho'Gath W Feral Scream; using Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on minions first can save a dash for Cho'Gath.
Chogath.fight: Start trading while Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture and get out of the front of Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, then use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions to get beside him. Cho'Gath has no mobility, so close the gap and pressure him then.
Chogath.laning: Early on, Yasuo is weak in trades, so don't overcommit, but pressure Cho'Gath to limit the time he has to build stacks. Don't carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions as paths to engage or escape with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes pierces minions, so stand out of the line of his basic attacks.
Chogath.phase: Yasuo gets stronger in the mid to late game after building at least two critical strike items. Cho'Gath also gets stronger as he builds stacks, though, so pressure his growth from the early game and don't give up a kill when health is borderline.
Chogath.teamfight: Instead of starting the fight, take an angle from the side, then engage with Yasuo R Last Breath off an ally's knock-up or a Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado. Before engaging, dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture and avoid the front of Cho'Gath W Feral Scream. After Yasuo R Last Breath, focus on taking out the backline.
Chogath.watch: Cho'Gath Q Rupture knocks you up after a warning appears underfoot, so dodge sideways when you see the mark and use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade if needed. Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences enemies in front of him and prevents your escape, so stay out of its frontal area. If at or below half health, create distance because of the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast.

Corki.build: Build armor first to account for the damage from Corki E Gatling Gun and Corki R Missile Barrage. Armor won’t block damage from Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb or Corki W Valkyrie, and health helps you withstand the true damage from Corki P Hextech Munitions.
Corki.combo: Build stacks by hitting minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then approach by dashing through a minion with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Hit Corki with the circular hitbox of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow up with a basic attack. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks Corki up, follow immediately with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Corki.escape: Right after Corki uses Corki W Valkyrie, he has no mobility spell available, giving you an opening to engage. Close the distance with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion, and if Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s knockup is ready, hit him with it and follow with Yasuo R Last Breath. Don’t force an engage while Corki W Valkyrie is available.
Corki.fight: Start a trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and you have two stacks of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to pass by Corki, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow up with a basic attack as soon as you land. Move to the side to avoid the frontal area of Corki E Gatling Gun, and block Corki R Missile Barrage with Yasuo W Wind Wall when it flies toward you.
Corki.laning: Keep minions as stepping stones for engaging or escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Don’t let Corki farm safely through his weak first five levels; pressure him when you have the conditions for a fight.
Corki.phase: Yasuo gets stronger in the mid to late game once he has at least two critical strike items, but Corki also grows stronger as he builds items, so it’s important to deny him easy farm from the start.
Corki.teamfight: Don’t engage first. Wait on the flank for the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an allied knockup. When an enemy is airborne, go in with Yasuo R Last Breath and target the backline. Put up Yasuo W Wind Wall toward incoming Corki R Missile Barrage, and stay out of the frontal area of Corki E Gatling Gun.
Corki.watch: Corki E Gatling Gun shreds your armor and magic resistance, so move to the side instead of standing in front of it. Corki R Missile Barrage also damages targets around the first one it hits, so don’t hide behind minions; move out of range. In particular, reposition to avoid consecutive hits from third missiles.

Darius.build: Build armor first to account for the physical damage from Darius P Hemorrhage, Q Decimate, and W Crippling Strike. If the healing from Darius Q Decimate is a problem, get Executioner's Calling for Grievous Wounds, and add penetration against Darius’s high armor. Darius R Noxian Guillotine deals true damage, so armor won’t block it.
Darius.combo: Hit twice with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build stacks, then approach Darius's side by using Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion. Cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit with its circular hitbox, then follow up with a basic attack as soon as you land. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks him up, follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Darius.escape: Engage when Darius E Apprehend misses or can’t be recast. While Darius R Noxian Guillotine is down, close the distance with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion and hit him with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Keep minions as stepping stones for your escape, and disengage if Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up.
Darius.fight: Take short trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield and your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks are ready. After Darius E Apprehend misses or is down, approach using Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion. You can dodge the blade edge of Darius Q Decimate by using Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to get close to his body. Back off before Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up.
Darius.laning: Keep minions as stepping stones for engaging or escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Harass right after Darius uses Q Decimate to clear minions or casts E Apprehend into empty space.
Darius.phase: Yasuo gets stronger in the mid to late game once he has at least two critical strike items.
Darius.teamfight: Wait for the tornado from your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an allied knockup before engaging with Yasuo R Last Breath. If you remain at low health with multiple stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage on you, Darius R Noxian Guillotine can reset its cooldown on a kill, so back off completely. After going in, use the armor penetration granted by Yasuo R Last Breath to target the backline.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, you’re likely to take follow-up attacks, so harass from outside its range and keep Yasuo E Sweeping Blade available to respond. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move outside the blade’s edge or stay close to his body to reduce its damage and healing. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up, create distance to drop them, and when your health is low, get out of range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine.

DrMundo.build: Build armor first to prepare for the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw or W Heart Zapper. Get Executioner's Calling for Grievous Wounds in case the duel drags on.
DrMundo.combo: Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases ignores the first immobilizing effect, so trigger it first, then look for a knockup with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Hit twice with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build stacks, then follow immediately with Yasuo R Last Breath after knocking him up with the third tornado. If his passive is still available, don’t expect Yasuo R Last Breath to work right after the first tornado.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so when you have an opening to get close, approach using Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions. To disengage, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on Dr. Mundo and keep minions as stepping stones for your escape.
DrMundo.fight: Start a trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and you have two stacks of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to pass by Dr. Mundo, hit him with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow up with a basic attack. Look for a long fight while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is down.
DrMundo.laning: Keep minions as stepping stones for engaging or escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Keep moving to charge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield, and stand behind minions to block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. After a trade, step on the canister Dr. Mundo drops as you retreat to deny its healing and passive cooldown reduction.
DrMundo.phase: Yasuo’s strong point is the mid to late game, once he has at least two critical strike items.
DrMundo.teamfight: Don’t engage first. Find an angle from the flank and wait for allied crowd control or the tornado from your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. When Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, target someone else instead of spending time trying to kill him.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits the first target in its path, slowing them, and is especially painful when you’re at full health. Keep minions between you and him or block it with Yasuo W Wind Wall. When Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, his healing and movement speed increase, so don’t spend a long time trying to kill him during its duration.

Ekko.build: Get Executioner's Calling first for Grievous Wounds to prepare for the healing from Ekko R Chronobreak. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Ekko’s damage.
Ekko.combo: Build stacks by hitting minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to pass by Ekko and cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash. Follow up with a basic attack as soon as you land. If the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks Ekko up, follow immediately with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Ekko.escape: Start a full fight after both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down. The moment Ekko E Phase Dive is also down, close the distance with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion and knock him up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Ekko.fight: Start a trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and you have two stacks of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Dodge the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, and look for a knockup with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive.
Ekko.laning: Early on, charge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield by moving around and avoid forced fights. Don’t carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; keep minions as stepping stones for engaging or escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Ekko.phase: Make use of Yasuo’s strength in the mid to late game, once he has at least two critical strike items.
Ekko.teamfight: Look to knock Ekko up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest right after he closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, or engage with Yasuo R Last Breath when an ally knocks him up. Avoid the area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence, and don’t recklessly chase an Ekko with Ekko R Chronobreak ready toward his afterimage.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the marked area to avoid being stunned and prevent Ekko from gaining a shield. Ekko Q Timewinder’s returning hit deals more damage, so move out of its return path. If you see the afterimage from Ekko R Chronobreak, don’t chase recklessly even when health is low.

Ezreal.build: Prioritize critical strike items and aim to have at least two by the mid to late game. Ezreal Q Mystic Shot deals physical damage, while Ezreal W Essence Flux and Ezreal E Arcane Shift deal magic damage, so don’t stack just one type of resistance.
Ezreal.combo: Build stacks by hitting minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then approach by dashing through a minion with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Hit with the circular hitbox of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow up with a basic attack as soon as you land. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks him up, follow immediately with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Ezreal.escape: The moment Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down is your window to commit. If you keep getting hit by Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, that window gets shorter, so approach from behind minions. When chasing, keep Yasuo E Sweeping Blade available to use on Ezreal.
Ezreal.fight: Use a short engage to draw out Ezreal E Arcane Shift when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and you have two stacks of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Right after Ezreal uses Ezreal E Arcane Shift, use minions as stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to get back on him.
Ezreal.laning: Early on, don’t carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, and move among minions to dodge Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. If poke has broken Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield, avoid trading until it recharges.
Ezreal.teamfight: Don’t trade poke with Ezreal from long range; look for an angle to approach from the flank. If an ally knocks him up or the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest hits, go in with Yasuo R Last Breath and target Ezreal, who has low armor.
Ezreal.watch: If you keep getting hit by Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, Ezreal E Arcane Shift comes back up faster, so move with minions between you and him. If Ezreal W Essence Flux marks you, briefly get out of range before his next attack triggers the bonus damage.

Fizz.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for damage from Fizz W Seastone Trident, E Playful / Trickster, and R Chum the Waters. Magic resistance is more effective than armor against Fizz’s main damage.
Fizz.combo: Hit twice with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build stacks. After Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to approach. Knock him up with the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then immediately follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Fizz.escape: Don’t engage just because Fizz Q Urchin Strike is down; look for the window before Fizz E Playful / Trickster comes back. While Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, close the distance with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and land Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s knock-up.
Fizz.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is ready and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks.
Fizz.laning: Minions are stepping stones for engaging and escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Look for a trade when Fizz misses a last hit with an empowered attack from Fizz W Seastone Trident and it goes on cooldown.
Fizz.phase: Use the same counterattack window in the mid game. Yasuo gets stronger in the late game once he has at least two critical strike items.
Fizz.teamfight: Stay close to allies to make Fizz use Fizz E Playful / Trickster first, then attack together once it is down. Yasuo should not engage first; use Yasuo R Last Breath in response to his own Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally’s knock-up.
Fizz.watch: Fizz E Playful / Trickster serves both as an engage and an escape, so save Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s knock-up and Yasuo R Last Breath until it is down. If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches, move away from allies before the shark erupts.

Galio.build: Build critical strike items first to prepare for your mid to late game strength once you have at least two. If you need defense, build magic resistance for Galio’s magic damage and avoid choices that add mostly armor or health.
Galio.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to prepare two stacks. Once Galio W Shield of Durand is down, approach by dashing through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s circular strike during the dash, then follow with a basic attack. If the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks Galio up, immediately follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Galio.escape: Don’t engage just because Galio E Justice Punch has been used; watch for Galio W Shield of Durand’s taunt and Galio R Hero’s Entrance too. In particular, while Galio R Hero’s Entrance is still down, wait for the taunt and dash to be down, then close the distance with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and land Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Galio.fight: Start a trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield and two stacks of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest are ready. Back off while Galio W Shield of Durand is charging; after the taunt and Galio E Justice Punch are down, approach by dashing through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Galio has relatively low armor, so Yasuo can pressure him with physical damage.
Galio.laning: Early on, don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions as stepping stones for engaging and escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Keep moving to charge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield, and avoid where the gusts from Galio Q Winds of War overlap. If Galio spends mana using abilities to clear the wave, push the lane to limit his ability to impact other lanes with Galio R Hero’s Entrance.
Galio.phase: Yasuo’s strong window is the mid to late game, once he has at least two critical strike items.
Galio.teamfight: If you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero’s Entrance, leave its area, and don’t commit your damage while Galio W Shield of Durand is charging. Yasuo should position from the flank rather than engage first; use Yasuo R Last Breath in response to his own Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally’s knock-up. Then focus on cutting off the backline.
Galio.watch: When Galio W Shield of Durand charges, it reduces incoming damage and extends the taunt, so don’t commit your damage; leave its range. Dodge Galio E Justice Punch when you see its backward wind-up, and avoid the spot where both gusts from Galio Q Winds of War overlap. If you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero’s Entrance, leave the area immediately.

Gangplank.build: If Gangplank Q Parrrley poke hurts, build armor first during lane. If fights drag on because of the healing from Gangplank W Remove Scurvy, get Executioner’s Calling to apply Grievous Wounds. Keep in mind that resistance cannot mitigate the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage.
Gangplank.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to prepare stacks, then approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade while Gangplank E Powder Keg has just been placed. Hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s circular strike during the dash, then follow with a basic attack after landing. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, knock him up with the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado and immediately follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage when Gangplank E Powder Keg has just been placed or after a barrel is destroyed. Approach through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, but save a dash to Gangplank when chasing. If you are likely to need to retreat, leave minions as stepping stones for your escape.
Gangplank.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks are ready. If Gangplank E Powder Keg was just placed and isn’t primed yet, use a minion as a stepping stone and approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, landing Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash and a basic attack after landing. Back away first if there is a primed barrel nearby.
Gangplank.laning: Avoid risky trades early and keep moving to charge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield. Don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions available for engaging or escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Don’t fight where Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed.
Gangplank.phase: Yasuo gets stronger in the mid to late game once he has at least two critical strike items.
Gangplank.teamfight: Engage with Yasuo R Last Breath after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado or an ally’s knock-up lands. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is available, watch for whether he uses it to remove crowd control. Also check whether Gangplank R Cannon Barrage has been used when deciding when to fight over objectives.
Gangplank.watch: If Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed, back away to avoid the explosion and slow. Don’t step where two barrels overlap, and destroy barrels yourself from a safe distance. Gangplank W Remove Scurvy removes crowd control and restores health, so don’t rush to finish him with a knock-up while this ability is available.

Garen.build: Get Executioner’s Calling to apply Grievous Wounds against the healing from Garen P Perseverance. Build armor first to prepare for the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment. Garen R Demacian Justice deals true damage, so consider your total health when preparing to withstand it.
Garen.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to prepare stacks. After Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack is down, approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash. Immediately follow the knock-up from the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado with Yasuo R Last Breath. Don’t use your knock-up and ultimate as Garen activates Garen W Courage; wait for its brief shield and tenacity to expire.
Garen.escape: The window to engage with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade opens after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s silence is down. If you dash directly to Garen with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, you can’t dash to the same target again for a short time, so leave minions as stepping stones for your escape if you may need to retreat. When Garen E Judgment starts, end the trade quickly and leave the spin’s range.
Garen.fight: Trade briefly immediately after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered basic attack has been used on a minion or spent, when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Use a minion as a stepping stone to dash past Garen’s side with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then use a basic attack immediately after landing. Don’t stay in a prolonged fight while Garen E Judgment is spinning.
Garen.laning: Leave some of the wave intact; if Yasuo Q Steel Tempest clears all the minions, you lose stepping stones for engaging and escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. When you can push the lane, use Garen’s limited ability to impact other lanes to create a numbers advantage elsewhere.
Garen.phase: However, Garen W Courage’s growth stacks are permanent, so pressure him as much as possible from the early game to slow his growth.
Garen.teamfight: Position from the flank instead of starting the team fight with Yasuo. Engage with Yasuo R Last Breath in response to Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado or an ally’s knock-up. Delay your knock-up and ultimate if Garen has just activated Garen W Courage. After Yasuo R Last Breath, focus on cutting off the backline.
Garen.watch: If you approach while Garen Q Decisive Strike is active, it’s hard to counterattack through the silence from his empowered attack. When Garen E Judgment starts spinning, leave its range instead of continuing to take hits. If your health falls below half, don’t stay within range of Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on missing health.

Gnar.build: Build armor first against Gnar’s main physical damage. Armor alone can’t stop the magic damage and max health percent damage from Gnar W Hyper / Wallop, so avoid choices that add mostly health. Then build critical strike items to make use of Yasuo’s mid to late game strength.
Gnar.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to prepare two stacks. Once Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, approach by following minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and knock him up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado during the dash. Immediately use Yasuo R Last Breath, then follow with a basic attack after landing.
Gnar.escape: Gnar E Hop / Crunch is Gnar’s only mobility tool, so immediately after he uses it, you have a chance to close in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Immediately after Gnar returns from Mega to Mini, he can’t transform again for a while, so look for an all-in then. Delay your engage if Gnar still has crowd control or is close to transforming.
Gnar.fight: Approach by chaining Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions, hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s circular strike during the dash, then follow with a basic attack. Right after Gnar transforms into Mega Gnar, avoid a direct fight and wait for the transformation to end.
