Gnar.phase: Yasuo has weak trades early, so withstand poke and manage minion stepping stones and your shield. In the mid game, track Gnar’s transformation cycle, avoid his Mega form, and look for a window in Mini form when Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down. Yasuo is strong in the mid to late game once he has at least two critical strike items.
Gnar.teamfight: Avoid angles where Gnar R GNAR! can hit you into a wall or in narrow terrain. Create distance when Mega Gnar has just transformed, and look for the vulnerable period just after he returns to Mini. Instead of engaging first, use Yasuo R Last Breath in response to Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado or an ally’s knock-up.
Gnar.watch: Watch out for the slow from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss. Mini Gnar’s boomerang can hit you on its return, so move out of its path, and block incoming boomerangs with Yasuo W Wind Wall. Mega Gnar’s Gnar R GNAR! stuns you if you are knocked into a wall, so create distance as his transformation approaches and don’t stand with your back to a wall.

Gwen.build: Get Executioner’s Calling to apply Grievous Wounds against the healing from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts. Build magic resistance for Gwen’s main damage, and consider armor if her empowered basic attacks are a concern. Gwen W Hallowed Mist increases her armor, so penetration is also needed to deal physical damage.
Gwen.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to prepare stacks. Once Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down, approach by dashing through a minion with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Press Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit with its circular strike, then follow with a basic attack immediately after landing. If the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado knocks her up, immediately use Yasuo R Last Breath.
Gwen.escape: Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is her mobility tool, so right after she uses it is an opportunity to engage. However, if Gwen hits something, its remaining cooldown is greatly reduced, so don’t recklessly chase where there are many minions. Leave minions as stepping stones for your escape even after using Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on your opponent, in case you need to retreat.
Gwen.fight: Start a trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is active and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Move to the side to avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, and close the distance with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade right after making Gwen use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash. Don’t engage if Gwen has full stacks.
Gwen.laning: Keep your distance so Gwen can’t land basic attacks, then look for an opportunity before stacks build on Gwen Q Snip Snip!. Minions are stepping stones for engaging and escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Gwen.phase: Yasuo is strong in the mid to late game once he has at least two critical strike items, but keep avoiding the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Gwen.teamfight: Position from the flank instead of diving in first; engage with Yasuo R Last Breath in response to an ally’s knock-up or Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado. If Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, don’t try to target Gwen from outside the mist; reposition or wait for it to end. After engaging, target the backline while avoiding the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals true damage, so don’t stay in a prolonged fight in front of her when she has full stacks; move to the side. Gwen inside Gwen W Hallowed Mist can’t be targeted from outside the mist, so enter it or engage after it ends. Watch out for the slow and max health percent damage from Gwen R Needlework too.

Hwei.build: Build magic resistance against Hwei’s magic damage, and get movement speed to leave the marked attack areas. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster deals damage based on max health, so be careful about choices that add mostly health. If you keep getting caught by roots or pulls, consider Quicksilver Sash between core items.
Hwei.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to prepare stacks, then close the distance by following minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s circular strike during the dash, then follow with a basic attack. If the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado knocks him up, immediately follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility ability, so the window to engage opens after Hwei E Subject: Torment is down. Approach through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, but save a dash to Hwei. If you need to retreat from the trade, dash to Hwei first and leave minions as stepping stones for your escape.
Hwei.fight: Start a trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks are ready. Use a minion as a stepping stone to dash past Hwei with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow with a basic attack after landing. The moment after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or wave clear is an opportunity to go in deep.
Hwei.laning: Be especially careful to back off right after your shield is stripped by poke. Minions are stepping stones for engaging and escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Hwei.teamfight: Don’t engage first; position from the flank and watch for Hwei E Subject: Torment to be used. Engage with Yasuo R Last Breath in response to an ally’s knock-up or Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado. Avoid paths where Hwei has placed eyes and zones, and target Hwei, who has difficulty retreating after you engage.
Hwei.watch: If you’re hit by the root or forced movement from Hwei E Subject: Torment, you’re likely to take follow-up damage. If the first ability hits, move immediately to avoid the second ability and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Watch for the eyes and zones Hwei has placed, and take a different route around dangerous paths.

Illaoi.build: Get Executioner’s Calling early to apply Grievous Wounds against Illaoi’s healing. Illaoi’s main damage is physical, and Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on max health, so build armor instead of only adding health.
Illaoi.combo: Dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit, and once Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is down, approach by following minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and knock her up with the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Immediately follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Illaoi.escape: The window to engage opens right after you dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit and make her use Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Close the distance with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade then and land Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Leave minions along your approach as stepping stones for your escape.
Illaoi.fight: Prepare Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks, then trade briefly. Dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit and approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion right after Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is used. If Illaoi R Leap of Faith is used, back away from its damage window.
Illaoi.laning: Don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions as stepping stones for engaging and escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Keep the lane away from walls and tentacles, and last-hit outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit’s range. Avoid risky trades early, keeping Yasuo’s health and Q stack speed in mind.
Illaoi.phase: Yasuo gets stronger in the mid to late game once he has at least two critical strike items.
Illaoi.teamfight: Destroy Illaoi’s tentacles if you can; if not, lure her away from walls. When facing Illaoi R Leap of Faith, don’t group up, and create distance while it lasts. Yasuo should position from the flank, then engage with Yasuo R Last Breath in response to an ally’s knock-up or the knock-up from his own Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Illaoi.watch: If you’re hit by Illaoi E Test of Spirit, you’ll be slowed and marked, so dodge it by moving out of range when going for a last hit. Watch out for Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash and the area damage near tentacles. If Illaoi uses Illaoi R Leap of Faith, create distance for its duration.

Irelia.build: Buy Executioner’s Calling first to reduce healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge. The available information is not enough to determine which resistance to build.
Irelia.combo: Hit twice with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build stacks, then approach through a minion with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Use Yasuo R Last Breath as soon as the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks Irelia up.
Irelia.escape: Right after you make Irelia use Irelia Q Bladesurge is your chance to engage. If Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun is also down, close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and land Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Irelia.fight: Start trading when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions to pass beside Irelia, hit her with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow with a basic attack as soon as you land.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave low-health minions between Yasuo and Irelia, reducing Irelia Q Bladesurge’s approach path. Minions are also stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Keep moving to charge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield.
Irelia.phase: Yasuo is strong in the mid to late game, when he has built two or more critical strike items.
Irelia.teamfight: Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet have a major impact in teamfights, so prioritize Irelia. Yasuo should not engage first; knock Irelia up with an ally’s knock-up or Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then use Yasuo R Last Breath.
Irelia.watch: Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge on low-health minions to approach, so create distance when minions are about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet and the area slow from Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Jax.build: Build toward at least two critical strike items. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both resistances if you need defense. Avoid stacking a lot of health alone, given Jax E Counter Strike’s damage based on your maximum health.
Jax.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks, then make sure Jax E Counter Strike has ended. Approach through a minion with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, use Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, and follow with a basic attack as soon as you land. If your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks Jax up, follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Jax.escape: Right after you make Jax use Jax Q Leap Strike is your window to close the gap. If Jax E Counter Strike’s stun is also down, go in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and land Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. If Counter Strike is still active, don’t go in; save Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to escape.
Jax.fight: When Jax E Counter Strike activates, stop attacking and back off with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, then go back in after Counter Strike ends. If Jax Q Leap Strike is also down, that’s your chance to close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Jax.laning: Don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; keep minions as stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape.
Jax.teamfight: When Jax activates Jax E Counter Strike and goes in, don’t group nearby; keep your distance until the area stun ends.
Jax.watch: Jax E Counter Strike negates basic attacks and, when recast, deals area damage based on your maximum health and stuns. While it’s active, stop using basic attacks and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, which counts as a basic attack, and use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to get outside the stun radius. After Jax closes in with Jax Q Leap Strike, also watch for a basic attack empowered by Jax W Empower.

Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for damage from Jayce W Lightning Field, Jayce W Hyper Charge, Jayce E Thundering Blow, and Jayce E Acceleration Gate. Magic resistance does not block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! or Jayce Q Shock Blast. In the mid to late game, two or more critical strike items increase Yasuo’s power.
Jayce.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks, then, after Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, dash through a minion with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to approach. Hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest in a circular cast during the dash to knock Jayce up, then immediately follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Jayce.escape: The moment after Jayce Q To the Skies! is down is your window to engage. In hammer form, check whether Jayce E Thundering Blow is also down, then close in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and land Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Jayce.fight: Start trading when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. If Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions, and save E to use on your opponent.
Jayce.laning: Early on, move side to side to dodge Jayce Q Shock Blast and farm defensively. Minions are stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Jayce.teamfight: Take an angle from the side instead of engaging first, and use Yasuo R Last Breath to go in off an ally’s knock-up or Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado. Look to engage when Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, then focus on taking out the backline after R.
Jayce.watch: When you see Jayce E Acceleration Gate, move sideways out of the line of fire because an empowered Jayce Q Shock Blast may follow. You can block cannon-form Q poke with Yasuo W Wind Wall, but also watch for hammer-form Jayce Q To the Skies! leaps and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow.

Jinx.build: Build armor first because Jinx’s primary damage is physical. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Jinx E Flame Chompers! If the enemy team starts fights with crowd control such as roots, fit Quicksilver Sash between your core items.
Jinx.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks, then approach Jinx with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions. For a basic trade, use Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash and land a basic attack as soon as you land.
Jinx.escape: Go in when Jinx E Flame Chompers! misses or has already been used. If Jinx W Zap!’s slow also misses, Jinx has no way left to create distance on her own. Conversely, don’t start a fight right after Jinx P Get Excited! activates.
Jinx.fight: Start trading when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. If Jinx is poking with Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets and has no minigun attack speed stacks, close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions. Save Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to use on your opponent until the last moment.
Jinx.laning: Be especially careful right after Jinx’s poke breaks your shield. Minions are stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Jinx.phase: Early on, Yasuo is fragile and builds Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks slowly, so play to survive and choose your trading opportunities. Yasuo grows stronger in the mid to late game as he builds two or more critical strike items, so look for an opening when Jinx’s root is down.
Jinx.teamfight: Don’t engage first; take an angle from the side and wait for Jinx E Flame Chompers! to be down or Jinx W Zap! to miss. Use Yasuo R Last Breath off Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally’s knock-up to go in and target Jinx. Don’t start a fight right after an ally dies or a structure is destroyed and Jinx P Get Excited! activates.
Jinx.watch: If Jinx E Flame Chompers! roots you, Yasuo Q Steel Tempest is interrupted and you lose time to deal damage. Dodge the slow from Jinx W Zap!, and when health has been reduced, stay out of range of a finishing shot from Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket! When Jinx uses Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets to hit minions, avoid standing beside them so you don’t also take the splash damage.

Kaisa.build: Build armor first to prepare for Kai’Sa Q Icathian Rain and her basic attacks. If you don’t have enough damage to kill her in one go, also account for Kai’Sa P Second Skin and Kai’Sa W Void Seeker by building both magic resistance and health.
Kaisa.combo: Keep Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks up by hitting minions, then approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion. As soon as the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks Kai’Sa up, use Yasuo R Last Breath.
Kaisa.escape: At this point, close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions, and save Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to use on Kai’Sa while looking for a knock-up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Kai’Sa E Supercharge can make her invisible or increase her movement speed, so watch her movement and land the tornado accordingly.
Kaisa.fight: Start trading when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion, press Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash that reaches Kai’Sa, then follow with a basic attack as soon as you land.
Kaisa.laning: Early on, Yasuo is weak in trades, so avoid overcommitting, but use Kai’Sa’s short range to pressure her off CS. Minions are stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. When Kai’Sa uses Kai’Sa Q Icathian Rain, stand near allied minions to spread out the missiles.
Kaisa.phase: Pressure Kai’Sa off early CS so she can’t scale through items.
Kaisa.teamfight: Take an angle from the side instead of diving in first, and use Yasuo R Last Breath off an ally’s knock-up or the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. If Kai’Sa goes in with Kai’Sa R Killer Instinct, knock her up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to create a chance to catch her. Before a fight, secure vision in side brushes and along entry routes to prepare for the invisibility from evolved Kai’Sa E Supercharge.
Kaisa.watch: If you're hit by Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, it opens an angle for Kai'Sa to engage with R Killer Instinct, so retreat toward your allies until the mark disappears. If stacks of Kai'Sa P Second Skin have built up, the lower your health, the greater the danger, so wait outside her range until the stacks expire.

Kalista.build: Build armor first to prepare for the physical damage from Kalista Q Pierce and Kalista E Rend. Stacking a lot of health alone also increases the maximum-health-based damage from Kalista W Sentinel. In the mid to late game, build critical strike items to make use of Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s critical strike.
Kalista.combo: Prepare stacks by hitting minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then approach through a minion with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Hit Kalista with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest in a circular cast during the dash, then follow with a basic attack as soon as you land. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks Kalista up, immediately follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Kalista.escape: Kalista has to start her basic attack animation to hop with Kalista P Martial Poise, so look to land Yasuo Q Steel Tempest at that moment. If you need to retreat, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on Kalista and keep a minion as a stepping stone to escape.
Kalista.fight: Start trading when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Kalista must start her basic attack animation to hop with Kalista P Martial Poise, so read that moment and hit her with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to approach, press Yasuo Q Steel Tempest as you dash past her, then follow with a basic attack as soon as you land.
Kalista.laning: Minions are stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. If Kalista has stuck multiple spears in you or her poke has broken your shield, avoid fighting and leave the lane until the spears disappear.
Kalista.phase: Yasuo grows stronger in the mid to late game when he has built two or more critical strike items, so look actively for a chance to fight then.
Kalista.teamfight: Take an angle from the side instead of engaging first, and use Yasuo R Last Breath off Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally’s knock-up. If Kalista’s support is nearby, spread out to account for Kalista R Fate’s Call. After Yasuo R Last Breath, focus on taking out the backline.
Kalista.watch: If Kalista’s basic attacks stick multiple spears in you, a single cast of Kalista E Rend can deal heavy damage, so don’t keep fighting with stacks on you. Kalista W Sentinel deals magic damage based on your maximum health, which armor alone can’t block. If Kalista’s support moves close, Kalista R Fate’s Call can be used to engage, so create distance in advance.

Karma.build: Build magic resistance first against Karma’s main damage from Q Inner Flame and W Focused Resolve. If Karma R Mantra empowered W healing makes duels drag on and become difficult, get Executioner's Calling to reduce healing.
Karma.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to prepare two stacks. Approach by dashing through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, then press Q Steel Tempest during the dash to knock her up with its circular hit. Follow with a basic attack as soon as you land. If the knock-up lands, finish with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Karma.escape: The opening to engage comes after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma E Inspire has ended. If the movement speed from Karma E Inspire is still active, she can create distance, so watch your Yasuo E Sweeping Blade path through minions before going in.
Karma.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and you have two stacks of Q Steel Tempest. Block Karma Q Inner Flame with Yasuo W Wind Wall, then use minions to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade after Karma W Focused Resolve is down. Don’t rush to burst Karma right after the shield from Karma E Inspire comes up.
Karma.laning: Don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions as stepping stones for engaging or escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Move behind minions or outside her range so you don’t take Karma’s spells for free and let her use R Mantra more often.
Karma.phase: Yasuo comes online in the mid to late game once he has at least two critical strike items, so look for fights then.
Karma.teamfight: If you engage first while Karma W Focused Resolve is available, she can catch you, so look for an opening until W is down. After the area shield from Karma R Mantra empowered E Inspire ends, use Yasuo R Last Breath with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally’s knock-up. After engaging, focus on cutting off the backline.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame slows and deals dangerous area damage, so block the projectile with Yasuo W Wind Wall as it comes toward you. If you’re hit by the zone from Karma R Mantra empowered Q, leave the circle before it explodes. If Karma W Focused Resolve tethers you, create distance to break the tether before it roots you.

Kassadin.build: Aim to get two critical strike items first. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Kassadin’s damage, and don’t prioritize items that prevent healing.
Kassadin.combo: Hit twice with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build stacks, then approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions. Immediately follow with Yasuo R Last Breath after knocking Kassadin up with the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest whirlwind.
Kassadin.escape: The opening to engage is while Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, especially after he has also used Kassadin E Force Pulse. Approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions, saving a dash for Kassadin, then knock him up with the Yasuo Q Steel Tempest whirlwind. While chasing, watch Kassadin’s mana to see whether he can cast Kassadin R Riftwalk again.
Kassadin.fight: Start a trade when your shield is up and you have two stacks of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to pass beside Kassadin, press Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow with a basic attack as soon as you land.
Kassadin.laning: Push the wave toward the turret, but don’t clear it all at once with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and remove the minions you need to engage or escape with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Pressure with your jungler to build a level and CS lead.
Kassadin.phase: In the mid to late game, Yasuo’s two critical strike items come online. Keep watching for Kassadin to engage and disengage in the late game.
Kassadin.teamfight: Don’t engage first. Follow Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s whirlwind or an ally’s knock-up with Yasuo R Last Breath. Then target the backline, but don’t stand alone within range of Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin E Force Pulse slows you and makes it harder to control distance with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so engage after it is down.

Kled.build: Kled’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Kled W Violent Tendencies and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only stack health. Reducing his attack speed gives you time to get away before Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth attack.
Kled.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to prepare stacks, then approach using Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion. Hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash and follow with a basic attack. If the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks Kled up, follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Kled.escape: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope hits you, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion to create distance before it pulls you in. Check that Kled E Jousting is down before engaging, and look for an opening before Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! comes back up. Then approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Kled.fight: Take short trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and you have two stacks of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Use minions as stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow with a basic attack. If Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, don’t stay on him for long; back off and go in again.
Kled.phase: Early on, Yasuo is weak in trades, so survive without giving Kled an advantage. Kled weakens after the laning phase and midgame, while Yasuo gets strong in the mid to late game with at least two critical strike items. Let the game go long instead of forcing an early fight.
Kled.teamfight: Use vision on the flanks to spot Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!’s approach in advance. If you can’t stop him from engaging, keep a formation with your tank in front so the backline isn’t hit directly. Yasuo should not dive in first; follow Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally’s knock-up with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Kled.watch: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope hits you, create distance before it pulls you in. When Kled W Violent Tendencies is ready, take a short trade and back off before his fourth attack. Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! comes from far away, so watch your flanks.

KogMaw.build: Build magic resistance first against Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, W Bio-Arcane Barrage, and E Void Ooze. Also get armor to account for his basic attack physical damage, but avoid relying only on health because of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage.
KogMaw.combo: Hit minions twice with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks, then approach by following minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends.
KogMaw.escape: Kog'Maw has no mobility spell, so the chance to approach comes after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends and you dodge Kog'Maw E Void Ooze. When chasing, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on minions to close the distance while saving a dash for Kog'Maw. If you are likely to need to retreat, leave minions as stepping stones for your retreat.
KogMaw.fight: Start a trade after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends, while Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up. Use minions as stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to approach, hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow with basic attacks. Kog'Maw has no mobility spell and relatively low armor, so once you close the distance, it’s good to deal Yasuo’s physical damage.
KogMaw.laning: Early on, don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions to approach or escape. Keep Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield charged by moving, and don’t force an engage right after Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle removes your shield or resistances. Disrupt Kog'Maw’s farming when you’re ready to engage.
KogMaw.phase: The mid to late game, when Yasuo has at least two critical strike items, is when he gets strong, but Kog'Maw also gets stronger over time. Disrupt Kog'Maw’s farming in the early to midgame and secure objectives and turrets to speed up the game.
KogMaw.teamfight: Set up an angle from the flank instead of engaging first, then use Yasuo R Last Breath after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally knocks someone up. Prioritize Kog'Maw, who has no mobility spell, and walk out of Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise’s explosion range immediately after killing him.
KogMaw.watch: While Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, watch its range and maximum-health-based damage, and engage after it ends. Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle reduces your armor and magic resistance if it hits, so dodge it from behind minions or block the projectile with Yasuo W Wind Wall. At low health, dodge Kog'Maw R Living Artillery and move out of vision. After killing Kog'Maw, walk away from the explosion of Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.

Leblanc.build: Build magic resistance before armor against LeBlanc’s damage. Also get a spell shield to block a combo starting with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice and movement speed to leave warned areas. If the enemy composition starts fights with crowd control that holds you in place, fit Quicksilver Sash between core items.
Leblanc.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to prepare two stacks. Approach LeBlanc through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, then knock her up with the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash. Follow with Yasuo R Last Breath immediately after the knock-up.
Leblanc.escape: Right after LeBlanc W Distortion is down is a chance to close the distance, but check that the time for her to return to her original position has ended before engaging. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to get outside the chain’s range before it roots you. When dashing in, use a minion first to save Yasuo E Sweeping Blade for LeBlanc.
Leblanc.fight: Start a trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and you have two stacks of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Pass beside LeBlanc with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion, use Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow with a basic attack as soon as you land. Don’t chase deep while LeBlanc can return with W Distortion; engage after the return expires or is used.
Leblanc.laning: Minions are stepping stones for engaging or escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Immediately alert your team when LeBlanc disappears from mid vision, and get river vision before pushing forward in a side lane.
Leblanc.phase: Yasuo gets stronger in the mid to late game once he has at least two critical strike items.
Leblanc.teamfight: Don’t engage first; set up an angle from the flank and wait for Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s whirlwind or an ally’s knock-up. When an enemy is airborne, engage with Yasuo R Last Breath and target the backline. If LeBlanc P Mirror Image creates a clone, identify which one is actually attacking before using your abilities.
Leblanc.watch: If you’re hit by another spell while LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice’s mark is still on you, the damage is higher, so back off until it disappears. LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains roots you if the chain stays attached after it hits, so immediately move out of range. If LeBlanc P Mirror Image creates a clone, don’t rush your abilities; identify which one is actually attacking.

Lux.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Lux’s main damage. If the enemy composition starts fights by holding you with crowd control, fit Quicksilver Sash between core items.
Lux.combo: Hit minions twice with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks. After Lux Q Light Binding misses, approach through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and immediately follow the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knock-up with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Lux.escape: Lux has no mobility spell, so the chance to engage comes right after you bait and dodge Lux Q Light Binding. When chasing, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on minions to close the distance while saving a dash for Lux.
Lux.fight: Start a trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and you have two stacks of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Bait and dodge Lux Q Light Binding, then approach using Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion. Hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash and follow with a basic attack as soon as you land.
Lux.laning: Minions are stepping stones for engaging or escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Lux Q Light Binding roots up to the first two enemies it hits, so don’t stand in a line with your allies.
Lux.phase: In the mid to late game, when you have at least two critical strike items, actively look for openings when Lux Q Light Binding is down.
Lux.teamfight: Approach from different directions, spread out from your allies so you aren’t all blocked by Lux E Lucent Singularity. Set up an angle from the flank instead of diving in first, then engage with Yasuo R Last Breath on an enemy your ally or Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks up. After engaging, focus on cutting off the backline.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, you’re likely to be hit by follow-up spells too, so dodge it with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade before engaging. Leave the area covered by Lux E Lucent Singularity, and dodge sideways when you see the red targeting line from Lux R Final Spark. If Lux’s spells hit you, create distance so Lux P Illumination’s mark doesn’t detonate with a basic attack.

Malzahar.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Malzahar Q Call of the Void, Malzahar W Void Swarm, and Malzahar E Malefic Visions. Consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar against Malzahar R Nether Grasp, and don't rely on stacking health alone because he deals damage based on maximum health.
Malzahar.combo: First remove Malzahar P Void Shift with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, and hit minions with Q as well to build stacks. Approach through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, hit Yasuo Q Steel Tempest in a circle during the dash, then follow with a basic attack as soon as you land. If the third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado knocks Malzahar up, immediately use Yasuo R Last Breath.
Malzahar.escape: Malzahar has no ability to create distance, so dodge Malzahar Q Call of the Void and look to close in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade when Malzahar W Void Swarm's summons are absent. If Malzahar can use Malzahar R Nether Grasp, suppression can interrupt your engage, so don't go in alone; fight when an ally can apply immobilizing crowd control to Malzahar.
Malzahar.fight: First remove Malzahar P Void Shift with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, and start trading when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest's tornado stacks are ready. When Malzahar W Void Swarm's summons have disappeared or haven't spawned yet, approach through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, hit Yasuo Q Steel Tempest in a circle during the dash, then follow with a basic attack.
Malzahar.laning: Back away from minions affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions. If Malzahar has shoved the lane, work with your jungler to remove Malzahar P Void Shift before engaging. This pressures Malzahar early and limits his chances to build up Malzahar W Void Swarm.
Malzahar.teamfight: If Malzahar W Void Swarm's summons are out, clear them first with an area attack, such as the circular Yasuo Q Steel Tempest cast during Yasuo E Sweeping Blade's dash. Don't jump in first; look for an angle from the flank, then engage with Yasuo R Last Breath when you or an ally knocks Malzahar up. If Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available, don't engage alone; get crowd control support from an ally.
Malzahar.watch: If a minion affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect transfers to a nearby enemy, so don't go for a last hit next to that minion. When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, move outside the two portals to avoid the silence and delay your engage. Malzahar R Nether Grasp's suppression can't be removed by Yasuo E Sweeping Blade or Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield, so don't enter an area where you have no vision alone while Malzahar can use R.

Naafiri.build: Prioritize armor against Naafiri's damage and build some health as well. If duels drag on because of the healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate, get Executioner's Calling for healing reduction.
Naafiri.combo: Keep your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks up by hitting minions, then engage once you have two stacks and Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield is ready. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions to pass by Naafiri, knock her up with the third Q, then immediately follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Naafiri.escape: Don't engage just because either Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers or Naafiri E Eviscerate is down; check whether she still has another way to move. In particular, immediately after Naafiri has used Naafiri E Eviscerate and before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes back, close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and land Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Naafiri.fight: Start a trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield is active and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions to pass by Naafiri, hit Q in a circle, then follow with a basic attack as soon as you land. After Naafiri E Eviscerate revives her pack, clear the pack and look for a chance to counterattack.
Naafiri.laning: Minions are stepping stones for engaging or retreating with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don't recklessly shove the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Keep moving to charge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield, and avoid fighting just after poke breaks it.
Naafiri.phase: Hold on early, when Yasuo has low health and his Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks build slowly. In the mid game, Naafiri's roams are most dangerous, so maintain broad vision. Yasuo grows stronger in the mid-to-late game after building at least two critical strike items, while Naafiri's pack is vulnerable to area damage in late-game front-to-front teamfights.
Naafiri.teamfight: Group with allies so Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit doesn't catch you alone. Don't engage first; follow Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally's knockup with Yasuo R Last Breath. Right after an ally dies, Naafiri can cast R again, so back away to avoid getting picked off in succession.
Naafiri.watch: If one hit from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers applies its bleed, create distance until the bleed ends so the second Q doesn't hit you. Naafiri E Eviscerate can revive her entire pack, so don't let your guard down even after clearing the pack. Naafiri W The Call of the Pack makes her untargetable for a short time, so wait until it ends to try to finish her.

Nilah.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Nilah Q Formless Blade, Nilah E Slipstream, and Nilah R Apotheosis. Also build health to account for the armor penetration on Nilah Q Formless Blade. If her healing prolongs the duel, get resistances, then buy Executioner's Calling to reduce healing.
Nilah.combo: Keep stacks up by hitting minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, and hit twice to prepare the tornado. After Nilah W Jubilant Veil ends, use minions and Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to approach, then use Yasuo R Last Breath as soon as your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks her up. When chasing, save Yasuo E Sweeping Blade for Nilah and close the gap through minions.
Nilah.escape: Look for an opening when Nilah E Slipstream and Nilah W Jubilant Veil are down. Nilah E Slipstream has a short cooldown, so don’t engage just because it’s down; knock her up first with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade or Yasuo R Last Breath. When you need to retreat, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on Nilah and leave minions as an escape route.
Nilah.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. If Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, don’t insist on using basic attacks; wait for it to end. To engage, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to dash past Nilah, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow with a basic attack after landing.
Nilah.laning: Prevent Nilah from finding an angle to engage, but move outside her increased attack range immediately after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits. Don’t carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions as platforms for engaging and escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Nilah.phase: Yasuo is strong in the mid to late game once he has at least two critical strike items.
Nilah.teamfight: If Nilah R Apotheosis is ready, spread out from your allies so several of you aren’t pulled in together. After Nilah engages and uses Nilah E Slipstream and Nilah W Jubilant Veil, look for a knock-up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Use Yasuo R Last Breath to engage after you or an ally knocks an enemy up. If Nilah R Apotheosis has already pulled you in, attack Nilah immediately to stop her from completing the cast.
Nilah.watch: After Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, her attack range increases and she attacks in a cone, so step back further. While Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, your basic attacks miss; stop trading with basic attacks and wait for it to end. If Nilah has R, keep your distance from allies so several of you aren’t pulled in by Nilah R Apotheosis.

Orianna.build: Aim for Yasuo’s mid to late game strength by building at least two critical strike items. Build magic resistance against Orianna’s damage. Movement speed is also valuable for getting out of the ball’s area.
Orianna.combo: Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to dash past Orianna, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow with a basic attack immediately after landing. If you’ve built stacks by hitting with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice, use Yasuo R Last Breath as soon as your third tornado knocks her up.
Orianna.escape: Orianna has no mobility ability to create distance on her own, so look for a chance to close in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade after Orianna R Command: Shockwave is down. It’s even easier to close the gap if Orianna W Command: Dissonance is also down.
Orianna.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Right after Orianna Q Command: Attack moves the ball away from her, it’s a good time to engage because she won’t have the defensive stats from Orianna E Command: Protect. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to approach, and save a dash to use on your opponent.
Orianna.laning: Keep moving to recharge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield, and back off right after it’s removed. Don’t carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions as platforms for engaging and escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Orianna.phase: Yasuo has low health and weak trades early, so survive while preserving your shield and minion platforms. Yasuo is strong in the mid to late game once he has at least two critical strike items.
Orianna.teamfight: Prioritize the ball’s position over Orianna herself and avoid areas reached by Orianna R Command: Shockwave. Instead of engaging first as Yasuo, look for an angle from the flank, then use Yasuo R Last Breath on an enemy knocked up by your tornado or an ally. After engaging, focus on taking out the backline.
Orianna.watch: Watch where the ball is placed by Orianna Q Command: Attack and move accordingly. Near the ball, you can be pulled in by Orianna R Command: Shockwave, so avoid that area. Don’t stay in a long fight while taking the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance and her empowered basic attacks.

Ornn.build: Build toward at least two critical strike items to reach Yasuo’s power spike. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so don’t build only one type of resistance. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about choosing items that add a lot of health alone.
Ornn.combo: Hit with the circular area of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow with a basic attack immediately after landing. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks Ornn up, follow immediately with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Ornn.escape: Don’t engage just because Ornn E Searing Charge is down. Look for an opening before Ornn R Call of the Forge God is ready, especially when Ornn E Searing Charge is also down; close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and land Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. If Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, engage after the effect ends.
Ornn.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Use minions and Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to dash past Ornn, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow with a basic attack immediately after landing. If Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, don’t advance; wait for the effect to end.
Ornn.laning: Don’t carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions as platforms for engaging and escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. If Ornn tries to forge an item in lane, get close and interrupt him.
Ornn.phase: Pressure Ornn to get ahead before his items and his allies’ Masterwork upgrades accumulate.
Ornn.teamfight: When the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God approaches, dodge to the side and don’t stand in the straight path Ornn will use to redirect it. Instead of engaging first as Yasuo, look for an angle from the flank, then use Yasuo R Last Breath when your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado or an ally’s knock-up lands. After engaging, focus on taking out the backline.
Ornn.watch: Watch for a knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge near the pillar left by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture or near walls. If a pillar appears or you see Ornn E Searing Charge’s windup, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion on the open side to escape. If the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath hits you and makes you Brittle, keep your distance to avoid the extra damage and long crowd control.

Pantheon.build: Build armor first against Pantheon’s main damage, including Pantheon Q Comet Spear and Pantheon W Shield Vault. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone. Pantheon has relatively high armor, so include penetration to improve Yasuo’s physical damage.
Pantheon.combo: Use minions and Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to dash past Pantheon, hit with the circular area of your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to knock him up, then immediately follow with Yasuo R Last Breath. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is blocking from the front, wait for it to end or attack from the side.
Pantheon.escape: Look to engage when Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and he can’t stun you. If you do so before Pantheon R Grand Starfall is ready again, close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, knock him up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then follow with Yasuo R Last Breath. Don’t rush in if only one of Pantheon’s mobility tools is down, since he can escape with the other.
Pantheon.fight: Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to dash past Pantheon, hit with the circular area of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow with a basic attack immediately after landing. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is blocking from the front, wait for it to end or attack from the side.
Pantheon.laning: Stand behind minions when Pantheon uses Pantheon Q Comet Spear to poke. Minions are platforms for engaging and escaping via Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon’s influence falls off in the late game, while Yasuo gets stronger with at least two critical strike items.
Pantheon.teamfight: Instead of starting a team fight as Yasuo, look for an angle from the flank, then use Yasuo R Last Breath when your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally’s knock-up lands. If you see the landing warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its impact area. After Yasuo R Last Breath, focus on taking out the backline.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault stuns a selected target, so don’t give him the range to use it. Stand behind minions when Pantheon uses Pantheon Q Comet Spear to poke, and don’t attack from the front when Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active. Yasuo W Wind Wall only blocks projectiles, so don’t count on it to stop Pantheon W Shield Vault.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy’s main damage: Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Don’t spend resources on magic resistance just for Poppy, and be cautious about choices that add a lot of health alone since Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health.
Poppy.combo: Hit twice with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build stacks, then, after Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, use minions and Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to approach. Cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit with its circular area, then follow with a basic attack immediately after landing. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks her up, follow immediately with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Poppy.escape: The moment Poppy E Heroic Charge goes down is your chance to close the gap. Confirm that Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended, then engage with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and follow the knock-up from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Poppy.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended and Poppy E Heroic Charge is also down, use minions as platforms for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to approach. Keep in mind that Poppy’s armor increases when her health is low, and only go deep when you can secure the finishing damage.
Poppy.laning: In the early game, build Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield by moving and avoid risky trades. Don’t carelessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions as platforms for engaging and escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Stand in open space so Poppy E Heroic Charge can’t slam you into a wall, and step on the shield dropped by Poppy P Iron Ambassador first to prevent her from recovering it.
Poppy.phase: Yasuo’s power grows in the mid to late game once he has at least two critical strike items.
Poppy.teamfight: Don’t engage first; look for an angle from the flank and wait for the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally’s knock-up. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, delay your Yasuo E Sweeping Blade engage, then use Yasuo R Last Breath on a knocked-up enemy. After Yasuo R Last Breath, focus on taking out the backline.
Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, it blocks Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and prevents you from using mobility skills briefly, so wait for it to end or walk in. If Poppy E Heroic Charge slams you into a wall, you’ll be stunned, so don’t stand with your back to a wall. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you, leave the area before the second damage triggers. When Poppy is charging Poppy R Keeper's Verdict, move from directly in front of her to the side.

Qiyana.build: Build armor first against Qiyana’s main damage. You don’t need to build magic resist specifically for the magic damage from Qiyana W Terrashape. Building a lot of health alone also increases the damage from Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, which scales with your maximum health.
Qiyana.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks, then use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to approach. Cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit with its circular area, then follow up with a basic attack immediately after landing. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks them up, follow immediately with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Qiyana.escape: Don’t go in just because Qiyana W Terrashape is down; wait until she has also used Qiyana E Audacity. In particular, before Qiyana E Audacity comes back up, dodge the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, and land Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Qiyana.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and you have two stacks of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. If Qiyana stays in front after using both Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity, approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and hit Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Save Yasuo W Wind Wall to block projectiles.
Qiyana.laning: Minions are stepping stones for engaging and escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Be especially careful right after Qiyana removes your shield with poke.
Qiyana.phase: Qiyana is strongest in mid game, so be careful not to give her an advantage then. In late game, Qiyana is relatively weaker, while Yasuo becomes strong with two or more crit items.
Qiyana.teamfight: Rather than engaging first, use Yasuo R Last Breath on an enemy knocked up by an ally or by the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Even when grouped with your team, position away from terrain so Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent doesn’t hit you all together. After engaging, focus on cutting off the backline.
Qiyana.watch: When Qiyana approaches with river element, move beyond the root range of Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. If she disappears with brush element, move into allied vision. When health is below half, keep your distance from Qiyana while she has rock element. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes and stuns when it hits terrain, so don’t stand with your back to a wall and avoid riverbanks and narrow passages.

Quinn.build: Early on, build armor first to withstand Quinn’s physical damage. Magic resist won’t help against this opponent. Then look toward the mid-to-late game, when you have two or more crit items.
Quinn.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks. After Quinn E Vault is down, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to approach, then hit with the circular area of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash and follow with a basic attack. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks her up, use Yasuo R Last Breath immediately.
Quinn.escape: The moment Quinn E Vault is down is your chance to engage. Don’t try to get close before then. After Quinn knocks you back, close the gap again with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and look for Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Quinn.fight: Prepare to trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and you have two stacks of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. When Quinn E Vault is down, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on minions in succession to close the gap, and save a dash to use on Quinn.
Quinn.laning: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, back off, then farm while you’re unmarked. Minions are stepping stones for engaging and escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Quinn.phase: Look for teamfights in the mid-to-late game, when you have two or more crit items and can make use of Yasuo’s strength.
Quinn.teamfight: Don’t engage first; follow an ally’s knock-up or the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest with Yasuo R Last Breath. If Quinn enters from the flank, look for a chance to catch her with crowd control.
Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, move outside her basic attack range so you don’t take the empowered attack. Dodge Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind the minion line, and don’t force an approach while Quinn E Vault is available, since it can knock you back and create distance.

Renekton.build: Get Grievous Wounds from Executioner’s Calling to counter healing from Renekton Q Cull the Meek. Build armor first against Renekton’s main Q, W, and E damage, but avoid the armor reduction from empowered Renekton E Slice and Dice through positioning.
Renekton.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to prepare stacks. When Renekton’s engage ability is down, approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion, then cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash and follow with a basic attack as you land. If your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks him up, use Yasuo R Last Breath immediately.
Renekton.escape: Right after Renekton uses Renekton E Slice and Dice is your window to close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. If Renekton W Ruthless Predator’s stun is also down, trade back with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Chase when Renekton uses E to disengage.
Renekton.fight: Start trading when Renekton P Reign of Anger is empty and Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up. Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to prepare stacks, then use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to dash past Renekton and cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, followed by a basic attack. Trade back right after Renekton has used Q, W, and E.
Renekton.laning: Survive the early game without giving up kills, and don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Keep minions as stepping stones for engaging and escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, but don’t stand in or behind a minion group where it can become a stepping stone for Renekton E Slice and Dice. Poke Renekton when he walks forward to build Fury, and keep your distance when his Fury is high.
Renekton.phase: If you avoid giving up kills and keep scaling, the matchup gets better from the mid game onward. Yasuo gains strength in the mid-to-late game with two or more crit items.
Renekton.teamfight: Don’t engage first. Wait on the flank for an enemy to be knocked up by Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally. When an enemy is airborne, engage with Yasuo R Last Breath, then focus on cutting off the backline.
Renekton.watch: If Renekton P Reign of Anger is above half or just below half, watch out for the empowered stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator and stay out of range. Empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator breaks shields first, so don’t try to withstand his combo with Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield. Renekton E Slice and Dice unlocks a second dash when it hits a unit, so don’t stand in or behind a group of minions.

Riven.build: Riven’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If Riven gets ahead, move defensive items earlier in your build and get health so Riven R Blade of the Exile doesn’t finish you off.
Riven.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks. When Riven Q Broken Wings is down, approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade toward a minion and hit with the circular area of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to knock her up. Follow with Yasuo R Last Breath when the knock-up lands.
Riven.escape: Don’t rush your engage when only one of Riven’s mobility abilities is down, since she can still escape with Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven E Valor. In particular, while Riven Q Broken Wings is down and Riven W Ki Burst is also down, approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and land Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Riven.fight: Start trading when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and you have two stacks of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. If Riven used Riven Q Broken Wings on minions, look for an opening before it comes back up, but keep an eye on whether Riven E Valor is still available. Interrupt her follow-up attacks with the knock-up from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest right after Riven gets close.
Riven.laning: Early on, don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; keep minions as stepping stones for engaging and escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Keep moving to recharge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield, and avoid fighting right after the shield is removed. If Riven Q Broken Wings is used to clear minions, trade back during its downtime.
Riven.phase: Yasuo grows stronger in the mid-to-late game with two or more crit items.
Riven.teamfight: Find an angle from the flank and engage with Yasuo R Last Breath when Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally’s knock-up lands. If Riven gets close, watch out for the third dash of Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven W Ki Burst, and interrupt her follow-up attacks with the knock-up from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. After Yasuo R Last Breath, focus on cutting off the backline.
Riven.watch: The third dash of Riven Q Broken Wings knocks you up, and Riven W Ki Burst stuns, so watch out for her follow-up attacks once she gets close. When you see her first dash, create distance with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade toward a minion. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her attack damage and range increase, and the damage based on missing health is dangerous, so keep your distance until it expires.

Rumble.build: If you need a defensive item, choose one with magic resist first. Rumble’s main damage is magic, and Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter scale with your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Rumble.combo: Build two stacks of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to approach beside Rumble. Cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash and follow with a basic attack immediately after landing. If you knock Rumble up, follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility, so engage after the movement speed boost and shield from Rumble W Scrap Shield have worn off. If you dodge both shots of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade using a minion as a stepping stone.
Rumble.fight: Start trading when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and you have two stacks of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. If Rumble W Scrap Shield is active, wait for the shield to disappear and keep trades short so you don’t stay in Rumble Q Flamespitter for long.
Rumble.laning: Minions are stepping stones for engaging and escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Keep at a distance where Rumble has to walk forward to fight.
Rumble.phase: Yasuo grows stronger in the mid-to-late game with two or more crit items.
Rumble.teamfight: Don’t engage first; find an angle from the flank and watch out for the slow from Rumble R The Equalizer. When an enemy is knocked airborne by Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally, engage with Yasuo R Last Breath. Then focus on cutting off the backline.
Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter deals damage based on your maximum health in a close-range cone, so don’t stay near Rumble for long. If the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon hits, escape with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade before the second shot or block it with Yasuo W Wind Wall. Also watch out for the silence from Rumble P Junkyard Titan and the slow from Rumble R The Equalizer.

Ryze.build: Build magic resist first against Ryze’s main damage. If the enemy team’s plan is to start fights with Ryze E Spell Flux and the root from Ryze W Rune Prison, fit Quicksilver Sash between your core items.
Ryze.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to maintain stacks, then close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks Ryze up, follow immediately with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Ryze.escape: If you dodge Ryze E Spell Flux or Ryze W Rune Prison is down, approach using Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion. If Ryze is casting Ryze R Realm Warp, you can cancel it with the knock-up from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Ryze.fight: Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to dash past Ryze, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, and follow with a basic attack as you land.
Ryze.laning: Don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; keep minions as stepping stones for approaching and escaping. Keep moving to recharge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield, and avoid trading right after poke removes it.
Ryze.phase: Yasuo’s strength grows in the mid-to-late game, once he has two or more crit items.
Ryze.teamfight: If Ryze has a mark from Ryze E Spell Flux, keep your distance from allies to avoid Ryze Q Overload spreading to nearby targets. Find an angle from the flank, then engage with Yasuo R Last Breath when an ally’s knock-up or the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest lands. After getting on Ryze, don’t give him room to keep cycling his combo.
Ryze.watch: When Ryze E Spell Flux marks you, Ryze W Rune Prison becomes a root and Ryze Q Overload deals more damage. Prioritize dodging Ryze E Spell Flux. If you’re hit, separate from allies and keep your distance until the mark disappears.

Samira.build: Build armor first against Samira’s main damage from Samira Q Flair, Samira W Blade Whirl, and Samira R Inferno Trigger. Then reach the mid-to-late game, when you have two or more crit items and Yasuo grows stronger.
Samira.combo: Hit Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice to build stacks, and hit minions if needed to maintain them. When Samira E Wild Rush is down, approach using Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion and knock her up with your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Follow with Yasuo R Last Breath as soon as she is knocked up.
Samira.escape: Dodge the enemy’s engage ability and go in right after Samira E Wild Rush is down. If Samira used that dash to engage but nobody died, close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and look for the knock-up from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Samira.fight: Start trading when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and you have two stacks of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to dash past Samira, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, and follow with a basic attack immediately after landing. If Samira used Samira E Wild Rush and nobody died, close the gap and look for a chance to take her down.
Samira.laning: Early on, avoid risky trades and recharge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield by moving. Don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; keep minions as stepping stones for engaging and escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Be especially careful right after poke removes your shield.
Samira.phase: The mid-to-late game, when you have two or more crit items, is Yasuo’s power spike.
Samira.teamfight: Dodge the enemy’s engage ability, and if an ally is immobilized, expect Samira to use Samira P Daredevil Impulse to close in on them. When there’s a chance to knock someone up with an ally or Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, engage with Yasuo R Last Breath. If Samira R Inferno Trigger starts, look for a chance to interrupt it with the knock-up from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. When retreating, don’t leave low-health allies behind.
Samira.watch: If you’re hit by the enemy’s crowd control, Samira can immediately close in with Samira P Daredevil Impulse, so dodge the enemy’s engage ability first. If Samira hits several types of attacks in succession, she can use Samira R Inferno Trigger, so keep any time spent close to her short. When Samira R Inferno Trigger starts, look for a chance to interrupt it with the knock-up from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.

Senna.build: If fights drag on because of the healing from Senna Q Piercing Darkness, get Grievous Wounds from Executioner’s Calling. Senna’s main damage is physical, so build armor first for resistance. If you keep getting caught by the root from Senna W Last Embrace, fit Quicksilver Sash between your core items.
Senna.combo: Hit Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice to build stacks, and hit minions if needed to maintain them. Approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion, hit with the circular area of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, and follow with a basic attack. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks Senna up, follow immediately with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Senna.escape: After Senna W Last Embrace misses, you have an opening to close the gap without worrying about its root. Even after the movement speed boost from Senna E Curse of the Black Mist ends, you can approach using Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion. If Senna W Last Embrace marks you, stop your engage and move away from allies.
Senna.fight: Start trading when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and you have two stacks of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Approach along minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, and follow with a basic attack as you land. Senna has no ability to create distance, so look for a chance to close the gap after dodging Senna W Last Embrace.
Senna.laning: Early on, don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions to approach or escape with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Watch where Senna will come forward to collect a soul, wait there, then poke her to disrupt the collection. To dodge Senna Q Piercing Darkness, move out of the line connecting Senna to the front minion or one of her allied champions.
Senna.phase: If left alone, Senna’s Senna P Absolution increases her attack damage and range, so disrupt her soul collection from the laning phase onward.
Senna.teamfight: Rather than starting a teamfight, find an angle from the flank and engage with Yasuo R Last Breath when Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally’s knock-up lands. After engaging, focus on cutting off the backline where Senna is.
Senna.watch: There’s a delay between Senna W Last Embrace hitting and the root taking effect, so move away from allies immediately when you’re marked. Stand behind minions to dodge Senna W Last Embrace, and move out of the line Senna Q Piercing Darkness travels along. If you’re hit once, back off so you don’t allow a second attack or ability, and deny Senna Mist collection.

Seraphine.build: Prepare for the healing from Seraphine W Surround Sound by getting Executioner's Calling early to apply Grievous Wounds. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Seraphine’s damage. If immobilizing crowd control interrupts your trades, consider Quicksilver Sash between core items.
Seraphine.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks. When Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, dash in using minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, then cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit in a circle. If your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks her up, immediately follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Seraphine.escape: Seraphine has no mobility, so the moment after Seraphine E Beat Drop is down is your chance to engage. Close in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions, but save a cast of Yasuo E Sweeping Blade for Seraphine. If you’re already slowed, prioritize getting out of Seraphine E Beat Drop’s line over engaging.
Seraphine.fight: Start a trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. When Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, use minions as stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to close the gap. When Seraphine is alone, away from her allies, it is also a good opportunity to get close and fight.
Seraphine.laning: Keep moving to charge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield, and back off as soon as poke breaks it. Don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; keep minions available as stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape.
Seraphine.phase: Yasuo is weak early, so endure Seraphine’s poke and avoid forced trades. Yasuo becomes strong in the mid to late game once he has at least two crit items.
Seraphine.teamfight: Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits an allied champion, so spread out instead of lining up with your allies. Set up from the flank rather than starting the fight, then enter with Yasuo R Last Breath off your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally’s knock-up. After engaging, focus on taking out the backline, such as Seraphine.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns targets who are already immobilized. If you’re slowed, first move out of the straight line in front of Seraphine. Seraphine Q High Note deals damage based on missing health, so be especially careful when your health is low.

Sett.build: Build armor first against Sett’s basic attacks and Sett Q Knuckle Down. Sett W Haymaker’s center deals true damage that resistances can’t reduce, and Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Sett.combo: Build two stacks of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest on minions, then approach while Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion to get beside Sett, knock him up with your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then follow with Yasuo R Last Breath. Sett W Haymaker can get stronger right after you deal damage, so dodge the center of its follow-up aim.
Sett.escape: If Sett E Facebreaker is also down, you can engage while avoiding the stun.
Sett.fight: Start a trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Dash through a minion with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, passing by Sett as you cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest mid-dash, then follow with a basic attack as soon as you land. After dealing damage, retreat through minions to avoid the center of Sett W Haymaker, then re-engage once his Grit fades.
Sett.laning: Minions are stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Keep track of Sett’s position relative to the minion wave to avoid the stun from Sett E Facebreaker.
Sett.phase: Early on, Yasuo is fragile and builds Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks slowly, so focus on surviving and setting up favorable fights. Yasuo becomes strong in the mid to late game once he has at least two crit items.
Sett.teamfight: Set up from the flank instead of engaging first, then enter with Yasuo R Last Breath off your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally’s knock-up. Don’t stand with allies on both sides of Sett, so you can avoid the stun from Sett E Facebreaker. After engaging, focus on taking out the backline while dodging the center of Sett W Haymaker.
Sett.watch: Sett E Facebreaker stuns if enemies are on both sides of him, so don’t get caught between Sett and a minion wave. Sett W Haymaker gets stronger after he takes damage, so trade and briefly back off; when he casts it, dodge sideways from the center of its aim. Sett R The Show Stopper suppresses you if it catches you, so watch where you’ll be thrown when Sett has R available.

Shen.build: Prioritize Tenacity against the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage and Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don’t focus on just one resistance; also avoid relying on stacking health because of percent-max-health damage. In the mid to late game, aim for at least two crit items to make the most of Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s critical strike chance.
Shen.combo: Hit twice with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build stacks, then use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to move beside Shen and cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest mid-dash. If the tornado knocks Shen up, immediately follow with Yasuo R Last Breath. If Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active, wait until it ends before following up with basic attacks.
Shen.escape: The moment after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is your window to retaliate. If Shen R Stand United is also available, don’t chase too far just because Shen E Shadow Dash is down. Before Shen R Stand United is back up, close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and look for a chance to knock him up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Shen.fight: Start a trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to close the gap, and don’t rush your basic attacks while Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active.
Shen.laning: Don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and remove the minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade needs to engage or escape. Then keep Shen occupied farming so he loses out when using Shen R Stand United to affect another lane. Alert your team immediately if Shen disappears or starts channeling.
Shen.phase: Yasuo is strong in the mid to late game once he has at least two crit items.
Shen.teamfight: Watch for the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash, and don’t initiate teamfights as Yasuo. Enter with Yasuo R Last Breath off an ally’s knock-up or the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then target the backline. Shen can join with Shen R Stand United, so tell your team where he is before a fight.
Shen.watch: If taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash, you’ll take empowered attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault, so leave Yasuo E Sweeping Blade’s path open to dodge the dash. You can also reduce damage by moving out of the path of Shen Q Twilight Assault’s spirit blade as it returns. Yasuo W Wind Wall only blocks projectiles, so don’t use it to try to block Shen E Shadow Dash.

Singed.build: Prioritize movement speed to make it easier to get out of Singed Q Poison Trail. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Singed’s damage. If the time you’re held by Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling causes you to lose damage output, fit Quicksilver Sash between core items.
Singed.combo: Build stacks by hitting minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then approach Singed with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion. Hit him in a circle with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest mid-dash, then follow with a basic attack after landing. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks him up, immediately cast Yasuo R Last Breath.
Singed.escape: Engage when Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling are down. Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so close in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions and hold him with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. To prepare for when you need to retreat, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on Singed right away and keep minions available as stepping stones to escape.
Singed.fight: Start a trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to pass beside Singed, hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest mid-dash, then follow with a basic attack as soon as you land. Don’t dash into Singed W Mega Adhesive, and don’t chase along Singed Q Poison Trail unless you have enough damage to finish him.
Singed.laning: Don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; keep minions available as stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape. Keep moving to charge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield, and avoid fighting as soon as it breaks.
Singed.phase: If you give up early pressure, Singed becomes difficult to kill once he has his core items, so pressure him to recall and don’t keep giving up lane.
Singed.teamfight: Don’t chase Singed to the ends of the earth or commit too many players to killing him. Hold him in place with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest while you attack his allies. Rather than engaging first, enter with Yasuo R Last Breath off your tornado or an ally’s knock-up and target the backline.
Singed.watch: Don’t chase a low-health Singed through Singed Q Poison Trail. You can’t cast Yasuo E Sweeping Blade while standing in Singed W Mega Adhesive, and if Singed E Fling hits you there, you’ll be rooted, so go around the adhesive. If Singed has his back to an ally, watch your position because Singed E Fling can throw you into the enemy team.
