Sion.build: Prioritize items with armor against the physical damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Q Decimating Smash, and R Unstoppable Onslaught. Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces your armor if it hits, so dodging E matters more than stacking resistance. Yasuo grows stronger once he has at least two crit items.
Sion.combo: Hit twice with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build stacks, and hit minions as needed to maintain them. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion to pass beside Sion, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest mid-dash, then follow with a basic attack as soon as you land. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks him up, finish with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Sion.escape: You can avoid Sion Q Decimating Smash’s crowd control by making him cast it early or dodging to the side before engaging. Leave a minion available to escape through when you go in.
Sion.fight: Start a trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Dodge Sion Q Decimating Smash to the side or make him cast it early, then approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions. When Sion W Soul Furnace is active, focus your damage to break the shield before it explodes.
Sion.laning: Minions are paths for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. If you keep letting Sion farm, his maximum health will increase, so disrupt his farming or make gains in other lanes.
Sion.phase: Yasuo is strong in the mid to late game with at least two crit items, but Sion’s maximum health also increases as he farms, so don’t keep letting him farm.
Sion.teamfight: Don’t engage first; set up from the flank and avoid the paths of Sion Q Decimating Smash and R Unstoppable Onslaught. Knock up an enemy with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally’s knock-up, then enter with Yasuo R Last Breath. After Yasuo R Last Breath, focus on taking out the backline and move away from where Sion falls.
Sion.watch: Sion Q Decimating Smash becomes dangerous if charged for too long, as it can stun and knock you up. When he starts charging, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion to move sideways out of the way. Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught travels in a mostly straight line, so avoid narrow paths and move aside. After Sion falls, Sion P Glory in Death revives him and lets him attack quickly, so immediately create distance.

Sivir.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet. If healing from Sivir E Spell Shield is making the fight drag on, get Executioner's Calling to apply Grievous Wounds.
Sivir.combo: Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion to pass by Sivir, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest mid-dash, then follow with a basic attack as soon as you land. Once Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks, wait for Sivir E Spell Shield to be down, then knock her up with your third Q’s tornado and follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Sivir.escape: Sivir has no ability to create distance on her own, so the moment Sivir E Spell Shield is down is your chance to engage. Wait for Sivir R On The Hunt to end, then close in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions and save a cast of E for Sivir.
Sivir.fight: Start a trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Draw out Sivir E Spell Shield first, then use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to close the gap.
Sivir.laning: Early on, don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; keep minions available as stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape. If you dodge Sivir Q Boomerang Blade, she loses the mana she spent on it. When leaving lane, either push the wave first or make sure an ally is ready to catch it, since Sivir clears waves quickly.
Sivir.phase: Yasuo is strong in the mid to late game once he has at least two crit items.
Sivir.teamfight: When Sivir R On The Hunt is active, take only short trades and wait for it to end. Set up from the flank instead of engaging first, and enter with Yasuo R Last Breath after Sivir E Spell Shield is down and you or an ally knocks Sivir up.
Sivir.watch: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade can hit both on the way out and back, so if you’re hit on the first pass, move out of its return path. Block a Q that’s difficult to dodge with Yasuo W Wind Wall, and avoid long chases while Sivir R On The Hunt is active.

Skarner.build: First decide whether to buy Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar to deal with the suppression from Skarner R Impale. If you build resistance, prioritize magic resistance against Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale.
Skarner.combo: Hit twice with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build stacks, then approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion. If you want to save Yasuo E Sweeping Blade for Skarner, move through minions as you approach.
Skarner.escape: Bait out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, and if it misses, use the window while his mobility is down to engage with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. If you’re stunned by a wall collision, Skarner E Ixtal's Impact comes back sooner, so don’t engage; back off. Also account for the fact that Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can’t break the suppression from Skarner R Impale if it’s still available.
Skarner.fight: Start a trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to pass beside Skarner, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest mid-dash, then follow with a basic attack as soon as you land. The moment after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down is your chance to close the gap.
Skarner.laning: Early on, don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; keep minions available as stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape. Keep moving to charge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield, and avoid trading as soon as poke breaks it. If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact stuns you against a wall, back off while accounting for how soon he can engage again.
Skarner.phase: Skarner gains both damage and durability as he builds tank items, so secure early jungle control and objectives to delay that point.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain, and if you’re grabbed and slammed into a wall, you’ll be stunned. Don’t position with your back to a wall; dodge in open space. You can’t escape Skarner R Impale’s suppression with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so be especially careful when you’re within its short range.

Sylas.build: Prepare for the healing from Sylas W Kingslayer by getting Executioner's Calling early to reduce healing. Magic resistance is more effective than armor against Sylas’s main damage, so choose magic resistance if you’re increasing your resistances.
Sylas.combo: Build stacks by hitting minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion. Cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit with its circular area, then follow with a basic attack immediately after landing. If your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks Sylas up, finish with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Sylas.escape: The moment after you dodge Sylas E Abscond / Abduct’s second chain is an opening to engage. Sylas can also dash away with Sylas W Kingslayer if it’s available, so watch for both abilities to be used and engage before Sylas E Abscond / Abduct comes back up in particular.
Sylas.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is active and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. After dodging Sylas E Abscond / Abduct’s second chain, check whether his other mobility spell is still available, then close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Sylas.laning: Avoid trading immediately after the shield is removed.
Sylas.phase: After you get Yasuo R Last Breath, you have a chance to get a kill by following up on a knock-up. In the mid to late game, make use of Yasuo’s strength once he has at least two critical strike items.
Sylas.teamfight: Look for an angle from the side instead of engaging first, and aim to knock Sylas up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest as he comes in with E Abscond / Abduct. Follow up with Yasuo R Last Breath on the knocked-up target before Sylas can heal with W Kingslayer. If an ally knocks an enemy up first, join in with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Sylas.watch: Sylas E Abscond / Abduct’s second chain is more dangerous than the first dash. If a chain hits, it knocks you up and lets him follow with more attacks, so save Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to dodge when the chain comes out. If Sylas Q Chain Lash clips you, immediately move out of range of the delayed explosion at the intersection.

Syndra.build: Buy boots early to get enough movement speed to dodge Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak on foot. Prioritize magic resistance, but also build health to account for the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.combo: Build stacks by hitting minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade once Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak is a long-cooldown defensive tool, so immediately after she uses it is your opening to engage. To go in, close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions; if you plan to back off, leave a minion as an escape platform.
Syndra.fight: Start trading when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is active and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Once Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, approach through a minion with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit with its circular area as you pass beside her, then follow with a basic attack.
Syndra.laning: Don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions to use as platforms for engaging or escaping. Delay your engage right after Syndra’s poke breaks your shield.
Syndra.phase: In the mid to late game, make use of Yasuo’s strength once he has at least two critical strike items.
Syndra.teamfight: Look for an angle from the side instead of engaging first, and avoid areas covered by many Syndra Q Dark Spheres. Knock Syndra up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally’s knock-up, then go in with Yasuo R Last Breath and target the backline.
Syndra.watch: Syndra R Unleashed Power is dangerous when health is low. Move away from areas covered by many spheres to avoid its range.

Talon.build: Talon deals physical damage, so build armor early with Cloth Armor. After that, build armor and health together; don’t prioritize magic resistance. If the healing from Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is helping him survive trades, get Executioner's Calling to reduce healing.
Talon.combo: Build two stacks by hitting minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then approach Talon by dashing through a minion with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Knock Talon up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash and immediately cast Yasuo R Last Breath. If you need an escape route after the fight, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on Talon and leave minions as escape platforms.
Talon.escape: Right after Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is down, you have an opening to close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. After dodging the returning blades from Talon W Rake, you can counterattack if Talon R Shadow Assault is also down. Don’t chase recklessly while Talon R Shadow Assault is available.
Talon.fight: Start trading when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is active and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. After dodging the returning blades from Talon W Rake, approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion. Right after Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is down, you have a chance to close the gap and land Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Talon.laning: Watch so Talon doesn’t level up before you, but don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and remove platforms for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Talon roams by crossing terrain, so share his position and ward jungle paths.
Talon.phase: In the mid to late game, Yasuo becomes stronger once he has at least two critical strike items, while Talon’s influence falls off.
Talon.teamfight: When Talon dives the backline, group with your allies and look for a chance to layer crowd control. Engage with Yasuo R Last Breath after knocking an enemy up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or after an ally knocks an enemy up. After Yasuo R Last Breath, focus on cutting off the backline.
Talon.watch: Getting hit by both the outgoing and returning blades of Talon W Rake makes his Talon P Blade's End combo dangerous. If the first hit lands, move out of the returning blades’ path and look for an angle to block them with Yasuo W Wind Wall. When Talon R Shadow Assault is available, watch for an escape and counterattack using his stealth.

Teemo.build: Teemo’s Q Blinding Dart, E Toxic Shot, and R Noxious Trap mainly deal magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. Then aim to reach the mid to late game with at least two critical strike items.
Teemo.combo: Build two stacks by hitting minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then close the gap by dashing through a minion with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit with its circular area or knock Teemo up with the tornado, then follow with Yasuo R Last Breath if the knock-up lands. If Teemo Q Blinding Dart is available, block it with Yasuo W Wind Wall or wait until it has been used before engaging.
Teemo.escape: Right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down is an opening to engage and follow through with basic attacks. Teemo W Move Quick increases his movement speed but isn’t a dash, so secure a Yasuo E Sweeping Blade path through minions to close the gap.
Teemo.fight: Start trading when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is active and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, close in through a minion with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Once you’ve closed the gap, keep fighting instead of taking a short trade and backing off.
Teemo.laning: Don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions to approach or retreat with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Watch out for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare while he’s stealthed in bushes without vision.
Teemo.phase: The mid to late game, once Yasuo has at least two critical strike items, is when he becomes much stronger. If Teemo gets too much time, mushrooms will pile up on key paths.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Traps around objectives and in narrow passages. Yasuo should look for an angle from the side instead of diving in first, then use Yasuo R Last Breath to engage and target the backline when Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally knocks an enemy up.
Teemo.watch: If you’re hit by Teemo Q Blinding Dart, your basic attacks are negated, so block it with Yasuo W Wind Wall as it flies toward you. Teemo R Noxious Trap is invisible and slows, so use Oracle Lens to check around objectives and in narrow passages.

Tristana.combo: Build two stacks by hitting minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Approach by dashing through a minion with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, then knock Tristana up with the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. If it hits, follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Tristana.escape: The moment after you make Tristana use W Rocket Jump is an opening to engage. If Tristana R Buster Shot is also down, close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and lock her down with the knock-up from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Tristana.fight: Start trading when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is active and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit with its circular area, then follow with a basic attack. If Tristana W Rocket Jump is down, close the gap with the Yasuo E Sweeping Blade you saved.
Tristana.laning: Avoid reckless trades early and keep moving to recharge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield. Stand next to allied minions to avoid taking area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge. Leave minions as platforms for engaging or escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, and pressure Tristana to last-hit under her tower when you can push the lane.
Tristana.phase: Both champions are weak early, so Yasuo should hold on and manage his shield and minion platforms. The mid to late game, once you have at least two critical strike items, is when Yasuo gets much stronger, but a fully built Tristana is hard to handle, so play to end the game before then.
Tristana.teamfight: Look for an angle from the side instead of engaging first, and follow your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally’s knock-up with Yasuo R Last Breath. Tristana can get takedown resets on W Rocket Jump and chain into your team, so retreat immediately if your allies go down and your team is losing the fight. Don’t leave vulnerable allies out in front when you retreat.
Tristana.watch: Don’t engage recklessly while both Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are available. Tristana W Rocket Jump is used to escape, but you can interrupt it with the knock-up from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest while she’s airborne. Don’t stand next to allied minions to avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge.

Trundle.build: Get Executioner's Calling to reduce healing from Trundle P King's Tribute. Prioritize armor to resist Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Trundle R Subjugate deals damage based on maximum health and reduces your resistances, so create distance while it’s active instead of stacking more health or resistances.
Trundle.combo: Build two stacks by hitting minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Approach using a minion as a platform with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, then cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit with its circular area. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks Trundle up, follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Trundle.escape: A good window to engage is after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and the effect of Trundle W Frozen Domain has ended. If you’ve been hit by Trundle Q Chomp, wait until the attack damage reduction ends. When you need to back off, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on Trundle, then leave minions as escape platforms.
Trundle.fight: Start a short trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is active and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions, hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, and follow with a basic attack immediately after landing. If you’re hit by Trundle Q Chomp or Trundle W Frozen Domain is placed, back off and re-engage after the effect ends.
Trundle.laning: Minions are platforms for engaging and escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. You’re at a disadvantage in long sustain fights because of Trundle P King's Tribute, so after chipping away health, immediately secure a gain or push the lane to force a recall.
Trundle.phase: Yasuo gets stronger in the mid to late game once he has at least two critical strike items, so look for team fights then instead of long solo duels with Trundle.
Trundle.teamfight: Don’t engage first; follow the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally’s knock-up with Yasuo R Last Breath. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, don’t stick to Trundle; target someone else.
Trundle.watch: Getting hit by Trundle Q Chomp reduces your attack damage, so avoid trading until the effect ends. Trundle W Frozen Domain increases his attack speed and healing, so back away from it. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks your escape route and slows you, so move sideways immediately when he places it, especially in a narrow path. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, your resistances are reduced and Trundle becomes tankier, so create distance.

TwistedFate.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can move out of the telegraphed attack location. If you build resistances, choose magic resistance to counter Twisted Fate’s ability damage. Build critical strike items for Yasuo’s mid-to-late-game power spike.
TwistedFate.combo: Build stacks by hitting minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. When Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is down, use a minion as a stepping stone and close in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit with its circular area, then basic attack as soon as you land. If your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks him up, immediately use Yasuo R Last Breath.
TwistedFate.escape: The window to engage is right after Twisted Fate uses the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Even while Twisted Fate R Destiny is down, close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and hit Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. When chasing, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion so you have a dash ready for Twisted Fate.
TwistedFate.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is down, use a minion as a stepping stone and close in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Twisted Fate has relatively low armor, so Yasuo’s physical damage is effective.
TwistedFate.laning: Minions are stepping stones for engaging with or escaping via Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
TwistedFate.phase: Yasuo is strong in the mid-to-late game, once he has at least two critical strike items.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Yasuo should wait for an ally’s knock-up or his own third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest before engaging with Yasuo R Last Breath. Target Twisted Fate when Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card has been used. If you see Twisted Fate cast Twisted Fate R Destiny within range, interrupt his movement with the knock-up from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card locks in the gold card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay out of its range. Dodge Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards poke from behind minions, and save Yasuo W Wind Wall for projectiles it can block.

Twitch.build: Get a Control Ward early to prepare for Twitch Q Ambush. Build at least two critical strike items for Yasuo’s mid-to-late-game power. Twitch E Contaminate deals two types of damage, so one type of resistance only blocks part of it; resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Twitch P Deadly Venom.
Twitch.combo: Build stacks by hitting minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then follow the minions in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Hit with the circular area of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then basic attack. If your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks Twitch up, follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Twitch.escape: After Twitch uses Twitch W Venom Cask, look for a chance to approach while avoiding its slow. Twitch has no ability to create distance on his own, so save a dash for him when closing in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions. If you’ve been hit by several basic attacks or are trapped inside Twitch W Venom Cask, don’t engage; back away.
Twitch.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Use minions as stepping stones to dash past Twitch with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, hitting him with the circular area of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then basic attack as soon as you land. Knock Twitch up when he reveals himself and you can close the gap, then finish him.
Twitch.laning: Early on, keep moving to build Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield, and avoid trading right after it breaks. Minions are stepping stones for engaging with or escaping via Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. If Twitch disappears with Twitch Q Ambush, avoid paths without vision and alert your allies.
Twitch.phase: Yasuo’s power grows in the mid-to-late game, once he has at least two critical strike items.
Twitch.teamfight: When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, don’t line up with your allies; spread out to the sides. When Twitch Q Ambush ends and he reveals himself, coordinate with your allies to focus the same target all at once. Rather than engaging first, Yasuo should wait for an ally’s knock-up or his own Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then enter with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Twitch.watch: If Twitch W Venom Cask lands at your feet, leave immediately to reduce Deadly Venom stacks. Once Twitch P Deadly Venom has stacked, Twitch E Contaminate can finish you even at around half health, so count how many basic attacks hit you and back away early. When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, his range increases and his basic attacks pierce, so don’t line up with allies.

Udyr.build: Build armor first to counter Udyr’s main damage. If he sustains through Udyr W Iron Mantle, get Executioner’s Calling for Grievous Wounds. Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals mixed damage, so armor alone won’t block all his damage.
Udyr.combo: Build stacks by hitting minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. When an opportunity comes, use a minion as a stepping stone and close in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, casting Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit with its circular area, then basic attack. If your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks him up, finish with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Udyr.escape: Right after you make Udyr use Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your window to close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. After the awakened state of Udyr E Blazing Stampede ends, knock him up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and follow with Yasuo R Last Breath. If you need to retreat, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on your opponent, then leave minions as stepping stones to escape.
Udyr.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Pressure Udyr when the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone to give him less time to heal. If you’ve already absorbed one stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, counterattack or retreat during the window when he can’t immediately stun the same target again.
Udyr.laning: Udyr appears from the jungle to gank, so ward key paths and jungle entrances. Don’t move forward while he’s missing. Don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, and leave minions available for engaging or escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Udyr.phase: Yasuo is strong in the mid-to-late game, once he has at least two critical strike items.
Udyr.teamfight: Yasuo should wait for an ally’s knock-up or the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest instead of engaging first. Use Yasuo R Last Breath on a knocked-up enemy to target the back line. Don’t force a kill on Udyr first when he has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle; take out weaker enemies behind him, then fight with a numbers advantage.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede quickly closes the gap and stuns, so keep your distance right after he activates a stance. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, and the latter also slows. Immobilizing effects don’t work during the awakened state of Udyr E Blazing Stampede, so knock him up with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest after it ends.

Urgot.build: Build armor first because Urgot’s main damage is physical. Urgot’s high armor can block much of Yasuo’s physical damage, so add penetration; aim to have at least two critical strike items by mid-to-late game.
Urgot.combo: Hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice to build stacks, using minions to maintain them if needed. Once Urgot E Disdain is down, use a minion as a stepping stone and dash past Urgot with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then basic attack as soon as you land. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks him up, immediately use Yasuo R Last Breath.
Urgot.escape: Right after Urgot E Disdain is down is your chance to engage with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. If you’ve also dodged Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, approach using minions as stepping stones, but leave one for your escape.
Urgot.fight: Right after Urgot E Disdain is down, use a minion as a stepping stone and close in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, then make a short trade so you don’t stay near Urgot for long. If Urgot approaches with Urgot W Purge active, walk out of range first.
Urgot.laning: Minions are stepping stones for engaging with or escaping via Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Keep moving to build Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield, and be especially careful right after Urgot’s poke breaks it.
Urgot.phase: Early on, Yasuo has low health and builds Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks slowly, so focus on surviving rather than trading head-on with Urgot. Avoid risky trades in the mid game too; Yasuo comes online in the late game once he has at least two critical strike items.
Urgot.teamfight: Set up from the side instead of engaging first, then use Yasuo R Last Breath on an enemy knocked up by an ally or by the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Watch for Urgot E Disdain’s engage, and after Yasuo R Last Breath, use your armor penetration to target the back line.
Urgot.watch: Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on maximum health, so don’t stay near him for long. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge is flying toward you, decide immediately whether to use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to avoid its heavy slow and the focused fire from Urgot W Purge. Watch for an engage from Urgot E Disdain, which stuns. If you’re hit by Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, get completely out of its range before your health reaches the execution threshold.

Varus.build: Build armor first to counter the physical damage from Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows. If the enemy team relies on roots such as Varus R Chain of Corruption to engage, fit Quicksilver Sash between your core items to reduce the time Yasuo Q Steel Tempest is interrupted.
Varus.combo: Build two stacks by hitting minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Follow the minions in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, casting Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit with its circular area, then basic attack as soon as you land. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks Varus up, immediately follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Varus.escape: Varus has no mobility ability, so avoiding a root such as Varus R Chain of Corruption creates an opening to engage. You can also sidestep while Varus aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow and close in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. When chasing, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion so you have a dash ready for Varus; when retreating, leave a minion as a stepping stone to escape.
Varus.fight: When you see Varus Q Piercing Arrow’s aiming animation, sidestep its path and close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions. If you’ve been hit by several of Varus’s basic attacks and Blight has stacked, retreat first, then go back in.
Varus.laning: Minions are stepping stones for engaging with or escaping via Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. When Varus aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow, sidestep its path and look for a chance to engage.
Varus.phase: Yasuo gets stronger in the mid-to-late game with at least two critical strike items, so prepare a path to reach Varus.
Varus.teamfight: Set up from the side instead of engaging first, then enter with Yasuo R Last Breath when an enemy is knocked up by the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally. If an ally is rooted by Varus R Chain of Corruption, back away to avoid spreading it. Right after an ally is killed, delay your engage until the empowered effect of Varus P Living Vengeance wears off, and plan a route past Varus’s frontline when you go back in.
Varus.watch: If you’ve been hit by a basic attack empowered by Varus W Blighted Quiver and Blight has stacked, retreat before Varus hits you with an ability and wait for the stacks to expire. Varus R Chain of Corruption can spread its root to nearby allies, so back away if an ally is hit. Watch out for the slow and healing reduction inside Varus E Hail of Arrows.

Veigar.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can leave the marked area of Veigar W Dark Matter before it lands. Veigar deals magic damage, so build magic resistance afterward.
Veigar.combo: Close in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions, hit with the circular area of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then basic attack. If you’ve landed Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice and built your stacks, knock Veigar up with the third cast’s tornado and immediately use Yasuo R Last Breath.
Veigar.escape: Once Veigar E Event Horizon is down, you have a chance to engage. Close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions, but save a dash for Veigar, then hit him with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest once you’re close.
Veigar.fight: Trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks are ready. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to dash past Veigar, casting Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then basic attack as soon as you land. Keep moving during the trade so you can dodge Veigar W Dark Matter.
Veigar.laning: Veigar Q Baleful Strike only pierces the first two units it hits, so dodge its poke from behind minions. Minions are stepping stones for engaging with or escaping via Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Veigar.phase: Veigar also has no cap on his stacks and grows stronger over time, so in the late game, check whether Veigar E Event Horizon is available before fighting.
Veigar.teamfight: First check Veigar’s position and whether Veigar E Event Horizon is available. Set up from the side, then engage with Yasuo R Last Breath when an enemy is knocked up by the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally. After engaging, focus on cutting off the back line.
Veigar.watch: Veigar W Dark Matter shows where and when it will land, so watch the ground indicator and sidestep. If you’re trapped inside Veigar E Event Horizon, crossing its edge will stun you, so move around inside and wait for it to disappear. If your health is below half, get out of range to avoid Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on your missing health.

Vex.build: Build attack speed to reduce the cooldown of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, and aim for at least two critical strike items in the mid-to-late game. Prioritize magic resistance over armor to counter Vex’s damage. Also consider movement speed to dodge marked areas and tenacity to deal with fear.
Vex.combo: Build two stacks by hitting minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Once Doom from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom has been consumed and Vex W Personal Space is down, approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion, hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then basic attack. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks her up, immediately follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Vex.escape: Right after Doom from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is consumed on the wave or for poke is your window to engage with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. When chasing, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion so you have a dash ready for Vex.
Vex.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Once the Doom indicator from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom disappears and the shield from Vex W Personal Space is down, close in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions. Hit with the circular area of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then basic attack as soon as you land.
Vex.laning: Don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions available for engaging or escaping with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. If poke breaks your shield, delay your engage until it recharges.
Vex.phase: Early on, Yasuo is disadvantaged in trades because of his health and the time it takes to build Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks, so focus on surviving and leave minions available as stepping stones. Yasuo is strong in the mid-to-late game with at least two critical strike items, so look for openings when Vex’s Doom and shield are down.
Vex.teamfight: Set up from the side instead of engaging first, then use Yasuo R Last Breath when an enemy is knocked up by Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally. Move low-health allies out of range of Vex R Shadow Surge first to prevent her from chaining her engage. If the mark from Vex R Shadow Surge is on you, move toward your allies so you can all target Vex when she dashes in.
Vex.watch: If a dash applies Vex’s Gloom mark, get out of her basic attack range and wait for it to disappear. Block the projectile from Vex R Shadow Surge with Yasuo W Wind Wall, but if it hits you and applies the mark, move toward your allies.

Viktor.build: Weather the early game while building critical strike items, then use your strength once you have two or more. Viktor deals magic damage, so build magic resistance rather than armor if you need defenses. Also get enough movement speed to escape Viktor W Gravity Field and his area attacks.
Viktor.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks, then use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion to close the distance. Cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit Viktor with its circular area, or knock him up with the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Follow the knockup immediately with Yasuo R Last Breath, and leave the area if Viktor W Gravity Field is placed.
Viktor.escape: Viktor has no dash to escape with, so he’s vulnerable after using Viktor W Gravity Field. Approach by dashing through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, while saving a Yasuo E Sweeping Blade cast for Viktor. If Viktor W Gravity Field is still active, leave its area before engaging.
Viktor.fight: Start a trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Use minions as stepping stones to dash past Viktor with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow with a basic attack as soon as you land. If Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, leave it instead of continuing the trade inside.
Viktor.laning: Don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; keep minions available as entry and escape points for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Stay out of line with the wave to dodge Viktor E Hextech Ray, and reassess trades as Viktor P Glorious Evolution augments stack up.
Viktor.phase: Viktor also gets stronger as his scaling stacks accumulate, so don’t expect the same results from an early-game engage angle in the late game.
Viktor.teamfight: Look for an angle from the side instead of engaging first, and use Yasuo R Last Breath on your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado or an ally’s knockup. Viktor has no dash and low armor, so avoid Viktor W Gravity Field, get close, and target the backline. Viktor E Hextech Ray can’t be blocked by Yasuo W Wind Wall, so dodge it to the side.
Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so don’t stand in line with the wave; dodge to the side. The ray passes through Yasuo W Wind Wall, so don’t rely on the wall. When Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, leave its area immediately to avoid the stun, and move out of the spot where Viktor R Arcane Storm is placed.

Vladimir.build: Build magic resistance early against Vladimir’s main damage. Get Executioner’s Calling for Grievous Wounds so he can’t sustain through the duel with healing. Consider Blade of The Ruined King for physical damage against a health-stacking Vladimir.
Vladimir.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build stacks, then approach by dashing through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. After Sanguine Pool ends, knock him up with your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado and follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Vladimir.escape: The moment Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends is an opportunity to land a Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knockup. You can also close the distance with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions when Vladimir E Tides of Blood slows his movement speed while charging. If you plan to retreat, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on the enemy and leave minions available as escape points.
Vladimir.fight: Approach through minions when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks are ready. Cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during a Yasuo E Sweeping Blade dash to hit with its wide circular area, then follow with a basic attack as soon as you land.
Vladimir.laning: Minions are entry and escape points for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Vladimir.phase: In the late game, it becomes harder to leave Vladimir’s scaling unchecked, while Yasuo also grows stronger with two or more critical strike items. Reduce his healing and look for an angle to engage with a knockup.
Vladimir.teamfight: Don’t group with allies inside Vladimir R Hemoplague’s area; if infected, re-engage after the effect ends. Look for an angle from the side instead of diving in first, and wait for an ally’s knockup or your own Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado. Use Yasuo R Last Breath to engage on a target knocked up after Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends.
Vladimir.watch: Vladimir Q Transfusion heals him and, when empowered, also increases his movement speed, so don’t force a trade right after your Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer shield breaks. When Vladimir E Tides of Blood is charging, put minions between you or move out of its range. If you’re affected by Vladimir R Hemoplague, the damage you take increases, so back off until the effect ends.

Volibear.build: Get Executioner’s Calling first to reduce the healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul. Build armor against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. Volibear E Sky Splitter deals damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Volibear.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks, then dash past Volibear with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit with its circular area. If the knockup lands, follow with Yasuo R Last Breath and basic attack after landing. Leave minions available for your retreat, and get out of Volibear E Sky Splitter’s landing area.
Volibear.escape: Wait out Volibear Q Thundering Smash’s stun outside his basic attack range, and engage after Volibear R Stormbringer is also down. In particular, close the distance with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and look for a Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knockup before Volibear R Stormbringer comes back. If only Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down, don’t rush in; account for his remaining mobility.
Volibear.fight: Take a short trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Dodge Volibear E Sky Splitter’s mark and wait for Volibear P The Relentless Storm stacks to fall off, then approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions. Volibear can heal with W Frenzied Maul, so don’t prolong the fight unless you have an opportunity to finish him.
Volibear.laning: Don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; keep minions available as entry and escape points for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. If Volibear Q Thundering Smash is active, escape through minions rather than running straight away, and run down the clock outside his basic attack range.
Volibear.phase: Yasuo’s health and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest stacks are weak early, so avoid trading with Volibear and weather the lane. Build critical strike items in the mid game, then fight actively in the mid to late game once you have two or more.
Volibear.teamfight: Don’t approach first while Volibear P The Relentless Storm stacks are up; look for an opening right after they fall off. Engage with Yasuo R Last Breath on a Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally’s knockup, then target the backline. If Volibear R Stormbringer is available, don’t stay under a turret at low health; if his leap is telegraphed, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to leave the landing spot.
Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash increases his movement speed as he approaches, then stuns, so run down the clock outside his basic attack range. If he closes in, escape through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. When you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, move to the side to avoid its damage and slow. Don’t take a fight while Volibear approaches while building stacks of P The Relentless Storm.

Xayah.build: Xayah’s main damage from P Clean Cuts, Q Double Daggers, and W Deadly Plumage is physical, so build armor first. If the enemy composition starts fights with crowd control that locks you down, fit Quicksilver Sash between your core items.
Xayah.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks, then use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to close the distance. If the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knocks Xayah up, follow immediately with Yasuo R Last Breath. If Xayah R Featherstorm is still available, your tornado and engage can miss, so check whether she has used it first.
Xayah.escape: Once Xayah E Bladecaller is also down, there’s less need to worry about being rooted, so close the distance with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and look for Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Xayah.fight: Take a short trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Use minions as stepping stones to dash past Xayah with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow with a basic attack as soon as you land. Don’t stay in one place for long; move out of the path of her returning feathers.
Xayah.laning: Early on, avoid forced trades and keep moving to charge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield. Minions are entry and escape points for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Don’t prolong fights where Xayah’s feathers have accumulated.
Xayah.phase: Yasuo’s power rises in the mid to late game as he builds two or more critical strike items.
Xayah.teamfight: If Xayah R Featherstorm is available, don’t engage first without a clear opening. After it has been spent and its effect has ended, engage with Yasuo R Last Breath on an enemy knocked up by your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado or an ally. Until then, look for an angle from the side; after engaging, target the backline.
Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots you if you’re hit by three or more returning feathers. If three or more feathers lie along a line connecting you and Xayah, move to the side instead of retreating straight toward her. Your engage and crowd control can miss while Xayah R Featherstorm is active, so confirm it has been spent and is no longer active.

Xerath.build: The available information isn’t enough to determine a specific first purchase. Xerath deals magic damage, so build magic resistance rather than armor, and prioritize movement speed to leave telegraphed areas and a way to handle stuns. Two or more critical strike items make the mid to late game a strong period for Yasuo.
Xerath.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks, then approach by dashing through a minion with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash to hit with its circular area, then follow with a basic attack as soon as you land. If your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado knocks Xerath up, follow immediately with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Xerath.escape: The moment Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down is an opportunity to engage. Even after blocking Xerath E Shocking Orb with Yasuo W Wind Wall, you can approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions. When chasing, save a Yasuo E Sweeping Blade cast for Xerath; when you need to retreat, leave minions available as escape points.
Xerath.fight: Start a trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to dash past Xerath, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow with a basic attack as soon as you land. If Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, close the distance on Xerath, who has no mobility ability.
Xerath.laning: Early on, keep moving to charge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield, avoid heavy poke, and farm. Xerath Q Arcanopulse can hit you even behind minions, so move to the side when he starts charging. Keep minions available as entry and escape points for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade; after Xerath spends a lot of mana, push the lane and call your jungler.
Xerath.phase: Two or more critical strike items make the mid to late game Yasuo’s power spike, and once he gets close to Xerath, Yasuo’s physical damage is effective against Xerath’s low armor.
Xerath.teamfight: Don’t engage first; look for an angle from the side. Use Yasuo R Last Breath on your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado or an ally’s knockup. If you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane’s cast animation, dodge or look for a chance to engage while Xerath is stuck in place.
Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so when you see him charging, change direction and dodge to the side. Walk out of the telegraphed area of Xerath W Eye of Destruction, and block Xerath E Shocking Orb with Yasuo W Wind Wall, since it can lead into follow-up attacks after a stun. If you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, dodge immediately or engage while Xerath is stuck in place.

Yone.build: Build toward two critical strike items, which are Yasuo’s power spike. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so don’t focus on only one type of resistance. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your max health, so be wary of choices that add a lot of health alone.
Yone.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks. Knock Yone up with the tornado from your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and immediately cast Yasuo R Last Breath.
Yone.escape: Don’t engage just because either Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone E Soul Unbound is down. In particular, look for an opening before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back; close the distance with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and land Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. When chasing, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on minions so you can save a dash for Yone.
Yone.fight: Start a trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion to dash past Yone, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, then follow with a basic attack after landing. Keep your distance first when Yone’s tornado is ready.
Yone.laning: Stay out of range of Yone’s tornado while he builds Yone Q Mortal Steel stacks on minions. Don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; keep minions available as entry and escape points for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yone.phase: Yone is also weak before he gets attack speed, so pressure his health and CS with safe trades.
Yone.teamfight: Look for an angle from the side instead of diving in first, and engage with Yasuo R Last Breath on Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or an ally’s knockup. Keep your distance from allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave doesn’t hit several of you. Yone R Fate Sealed sends Yone behind the last champion in its path, so before a teamfight, check that you aren’t standing alone at the very back of your formation.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, he’s preparing his tornado, so wait outside its range for the stacks to expire. After Yone enters with Yone E Soul Unbound, he can deal extra damage on his return, so if your health is low, get out of range before then.

Yorick.build: If the healing from Yorick Q Last Rites is too much, get Executioner’s Calling early to reduce his healing. Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Yorick Q Last Rites and Mist Walkers. Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles deal damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Yorick.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build stacks, and after Yorick E Mourning Mist is down, approach through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s circular area during the dash, then follow with a basic attack. If your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado knocks Yorick up, immediately follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Yorick.escape: The time when Yorick E Mourning Mist misses or is down is your opportunity to engage. If Yorick W Dark Procession is also down, close the distance with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and land Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Leave minions available as stepping stones for your retreat.
Yorick.fight: Start a short trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. If Yorick E Mourning Mist misses or is down, use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade on a minion to approach, hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s circular area during the dash, then follow with a basic attack. Clear Mist Walkers before fighting.
Yorick.laning: Don’t fight where Yorick has accumulated a lot of graves nearby. Push the lane so Yorick can’t clear the wave and build graves on his side, but don’t clear every minion with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; keep some for engaging and retreating with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. If poke breaks Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield, recharge it before trading.
Yorick.phase: Two or more critical strike items make the mid to late game Yasuo’s power spike; keep an eye on Yorick’s side lane pressure even then.
Yorick.teamfight: Instead of starting the fight yourself, use Yasuo R Last Breath on your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado or an ally’s knockup. Before engaging, look for an angle from the side and use minions as stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. After Yasuo R Last Breath, focus on cutting off the backline.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows and marks you, and deals damage based on your max health, so watch its arc and dodge. If you’re trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, attack the wall or find a route over it with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. After Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles, if the Maiden of the Mist marks you, move away from Yorick himself.

Zed.build: Build armor first to withstand one full set of Zed’s physical damage. Zed P Contempt for the Weak deals magic damage that armor can’t block and scales with your max health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Zed.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks. Use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through a minion to approach, hit with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s circular area during the dash, then follow with a basic attack. If your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado knocks Zed up, immediately cast Yasuo R Last Breath.
Zed.escape: If Zed uses Zed W Living Shadow, look for an opportunity to engage after the shadow disappears or Zed has already swapped positions with it. If only Zed W Living Shadow is down, he can escape with Zed R Death Mark, so in particular look for an opening before Zed R Death Mark comes back. Move out of the slow area from Zed E Shadow Slash, then close the distance with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade and land a Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knockup.
Zed.fight: Start a trade when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is up and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Use a minion as a stepping stone to dash past Zed with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, cast Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, then follow with a basic attack as soon as you land. Right after Zed uses Zed W Living Shadow, check whether the shadow has disappeared or Zed has already swapped positions with it before closing in.
Zed.laning: Early on, don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; keep minions available as entry and escape points for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Keep moving to charge Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield, and avoid fighting right after Zed’s poke breaks it.
Zed.phase: Yasuo is weak early, so weather the lane without giving Zed an advantage. When Zed is strong in the mid game, avoid getting caught alone and move around with allies. Zed’s power falls off late, while Yasuo gets stronger with two or more critical strike items, so use that timing.
Zed.teamfight: Yasuo shouldn’t start teamfights; look for an engage angle from the side. When an enemy is knocked up by an ally or your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado, go in with Yasuo R Last Breath. After engaging, focus on cutting off the backline.
Zed.watch: Watch out for a full combo from Zed Q Razor Shuriken, Zed E Shadow Slash, and Zed R Death Mark. Track Zed W Living Shadow and move out of the slow area of Zed E Shadow Slash from his shadow. If Zed R Death Mark is on you, interrupt his follow-up damage with a Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knockup.

Zeri.build: Build armor first to reduce the physical damage from Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. Zeri P Living Battery deals damage based on your maximum health and executes you at low health, so be careful about choices that only add a large amount of health. By mid-to-late game, get at least two critical strike items, which are a strength for Yasuo.
Zeri.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to prepare stacks, then approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions. During the dash, use Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to hit with its wide circular hitbox, then follow with a basic attack. If your third Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado knocks Zeri up, follow immediately with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Zeri.escape: The window to engage is right after you force Zeri to use Zeri E Spark Surge. She can cross a wall to escape far away, so approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade in open terrain away from walls and look for a Yasuo Q Steel Tempest knock-up. Don’t force a chase while Zeri R Lightning Crash is active.
Zeri.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is active and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Dash through a minion with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, passing by Zeri, and use Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash, followed by a basic attack as soon as you land. Right after Zeri E Spark Surge is used, close the gap and look for a knock-up.
Zeri.laning: Don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest; leave minions as stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or retreat. Look for a kill before Zeri finishes her core items, especially after you learn Yasuo R Last Breath.
Zeri.phase: Yasuo becomes strong in the mid-to-late game with at least two critical strike items, but a grown Zeri becomes difficult to pick off because of her mobility.
Zeri.teamfight: Instead of starting the teamfight first, take an angle from the flank and wait for a Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado or an ally’s knock-up. When Zeri is airborne, engage with Yasuo R Last Breath and target the backline. If Zeri R Lightning Crash is active and she’s moving faster, don’t chase her on foot; look for a chance to stop her with an immobilizing effect.
Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads widely when it hits terrain, so don’t fight with your back to a wall or in a narrow passage. The beam passes through Yasuo W Wind Wall, so dodge it by changing position. Zeri R Lightning Crash increases her movement speed, so don’t chase her on foot.

Ziggs.build: Survive the early game and aim for the mid-to-late game, when you have at least two critical strike items. Build magic resistance rather than armor to reduce Ziggs’s damage, and get enough movement speed to walk out of marked explosion zones.
Ziggs.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to build two stacks, then approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions.
Ziggs.escape: The moment after Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down is your window to engage. If Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield blocks your approach, don’t go that way; find a route without mines, then close in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Ziggs.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is active and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade through minions and hit him with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest during the dash.
Ziggs.laning: Minions are stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Look for an opening right after Ziggs uses Ziggs W Satchel Charge to poke or clear the wave.
Ziggs.teamfight: Take an angle from the flank instead of diving in first, and use Yasuo R Last Breath when an ally knocks someone up or your Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado hits. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, target Ziggs; if it’s still available, account for vision beyond walls and your approach route as well. Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb can reach you from far away, so don’t group together in one spot around objectives.
Ziggs.watch: Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield slows you and makes it easier for him to hit you with other abilities, so detour around the mines or wait for them to disappear. If you see the area of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb, move away from the center of the explosion even if you can’t get completely clear.

Zoe.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can dodge one shot of Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. If you build resistance, choose magic resistance over armor, but you’ll need health to withstand the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble.
Zoe.combo: Hit minions with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to maintain stacks, and once you have two, approach toward a minion with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Zoe.escape: If Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, aim Yasuo Q Steel Tempest at the spot where she started, since she must return there.
Zoe.fight: Start trades when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is active and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has two stacks. Right after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble misses, chain Yasuo E Sweeping Blade casts through minions to approach, and save a dash to use on her.
Zoe.laning: Minions are stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage or escape, so don’t recklessly push the wave with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Also avoid the trap left by Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble when it misses.
Zoe.phase: Yasuo hits his power spike in the mid-to-late game, when he has at least two critical strike items.
Zoe.teamfight: Instead of engaging first, take an angle from the flank and wait for a Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado or an ally’s knock-up. Once Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade; when Zoe is airborne, go in with Yasuo R Last Breath and target the backline.
Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, you’ll fall asleep a moment later, so move behind a wall or an ally before then and get out of Zoe Q Paddle Star!’s angle and range. When you see Zoe prepare to throw Zoe Q Paddle Star!, block the projectile with Yasuo W Wind Wall, or interrupt her re-aiming with Yasuo Q Steel Tempest if you’re ready to knock her up.
